thread.label: Genesis 3:1-6
thread.text: Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the Lord God had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?

classes.title: Popular Persuasions: Fighting Against Heaven Defending Earth

precepts.label: Ecclesiastes 3:18
precepts.why:
“Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the Lord God had made.” The serpent is counted among the beasts, and in the scriptures the Most High compares men to beasts. Solomon wrote, “I said in mine heart concerning the estate of the sons of men, that God might manifest them, and that they might see that they themselves are beasts.” So the serpent in Genesis 3 is a representation of a man.

He was more subtle than any beast: more crafty, better with his lies, better with his persuasion. Satan’s first weapon was persuasion. Eve was not subdued physically; he did not grab her. He came to her with words. “Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?” Notice what he brings: doubt and fear. Eve answered correctly, that God had said “Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.” Then came the doubt: “Ye shall not surely die,” and “ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.” She was already meant to be eternal, but he threw doubt in to persuade her to eat.

“she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.” She was persuaded by the serpent, and then she defiled Adam as well. The serpent used no force; he used words to sway Eve’s perception of reality, and then she went into sin. He went to the woman first, which is why the woman is to learn from her husband at home.

That same serpent spirit is still speaking. Christ told the Pharisees, “Ye are of your father the devil,” “a liar, and the father of it.” The serpent seed came through Cain, and it lives on in Esau, the so-called white man, the pioneer of lying, who persuades the world today through his media and his religion. It is a battle for the minds of the people, and the answer is to stay in the word.

classes.title: Raising Cain: The Son of Perdition, Merchants, and Captive Nations

precepts.label: Romans 9:13
precepts.why:
Cain “brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the Lord”, and Abel brought “of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof.” “And the Lord had respect unto Abel and to his offering: But unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect.” What happened to Cain and Abel physically is a foreshadowing of Jacob and Esau spiritually: one is chosen and one is not.

Paul explains it with Rebecca’s twins: “For the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth”. Then: “As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.” Cain was not rejected because he was wroth; that was ordained from the beginning. It is about election, the purpose God makes. He can make one vessel for one use and another vessel of wrath fitted for destruction.

Christians take “not of works” to mean the law need not be kept. What it tells us is that from the foundation God chose his elect. He still requires the works of the law, not the sacrificial law, but being clean and repented, to obtain the kingdom of heaven. When the first world was formed every nation was supposed to follow the laws, and judgment followed whoever did not. Cain’s rebellious nature showed itself, and it continues to this day in Esau.

People say God doesn’t hate, and they isolate “God is love.” But notice it says “as it is written”: it is in the Bible. It was written first in Malachi: “Was not Esau Jacob’s brother? saith the Lord: yet I loved Jacob, And I hated Esau, and laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness.” Edom says, “We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places”, and he did, in the Renaissance. But the Lord says, “They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.” God lets him rise to power so that he can take him down.

And the Lord asked Cain, “Why art thou wroth? and why is thy countenance fallen?” Remember that, because the same reason Cain hated Abel is the reason Esau hates Jacob today. It is the same spirit; only the name changes. “Satan” simply means adversary, one who obstructs and opposes. That is why everything they do is about us: they were made for that purpose, to obstruct and oppose us, because God purposed it from the beginning.

thread.label: Genesis 4:9
thread.text: And the Lord said unto Cain, Where is Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: Am I my brother’s keeper?

classes.title: Raising Cain: The Son of Perdition, Merchants, and Captive Nations

precepts.label: Job 10:14
precepts.why:
The Lord asked Cain, “Where is Abel thy brother?”, and he answered, “I know not: Am I my brother’s keeper?” But “the voice of thy brother’s blood crieth unto me from the ground. And now art thou cursed from the earth”. That curse is layered, but the ultimate curse is the utter destruction of Cain and his seed, and it has not yet been fulfilled. It is a deferred judgment, held “until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled”: a set time that has to be fulfilled of these heathen nations, starting with Esau as the top one. It is the same spirit of Cain today. Unless we accept who this man is, the son of perdition, nothing else about the last days will make sense.

The Lord told him, “a fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth”. Apart from the little land he had in the kingdom of Esau, he takes up the identity of others: he calls himself the Greeks, when the real Greeks were black, of the Japhetic seed; the Romans; the last samurai; the Israelites and the Egyptians in The Ten Commandments. The confusion of faces was supposed to be his curse, and he flipped it onto us, until we became the astonishment, the proverb and the byword.

Cain feared that “every one that findeth me shall slay me”, and “the Lord set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should kill him.” Why not judge him right then? Because God had a purpose for him, as he raised up Pharaoh so that his power would be magnified when he comes to redeem his people and the earth.

Job tells us what the mark is: “If I sin, then thou markest me, and thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.” The mark is sin. And sin preserves him, because sin is witchcraft: by it he seduces the nations that might stand against him into the confederacy of Psalm 83. They all know what he is, but lust, the love of money and power, make them put that aside and ally with him, the way criminals make alliances knowing one day someone will stab them in the back. Under Trump that confederacy is starting to crack.

So Cain is protected only for a time. The judgment was promised through Esau: “I hated Esau, and laid his mountains and his heritage waste”, and they shall call them “The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.” That border of wickedness is the mark. “The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, and who is he?” If not Esau, the United States of America, who is he? And “evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him”: his demise will come the same way he ruled.

precepts.label: Wisdom of Solomon 4:12
precepts.why:
Why would a mark of sin protect Cain? Solomon answers: “For the bewitching of naughtiness doth obscure things that are honest; and the wandering of concupiscence doth undermine the simple mind.” Sin is bewitching. It is seductive. It hides what is honest, so that, as the scripture says, if it were possible even the elect would be deceived.

That is how the mark works. Cain’s line would have rulership for a time, and he would rule the earth with darkness, with sin and with evil, and people would be enticed by it, Israelites included. Our northern kingdom, the majority of it, fell for it, and now they are getting their wake-up call, though there was always a remnant that rebelled against the colonialism they saw in Latin America.

The bewitching is also how the confederacy holds together. The other nations know what he stands for; it is common knowledge. But the love of money, power and rulership says, put that aside, this is the one it was given to, nobody else could get me these things. So they ally with him, and there is no honor among thieves with this man. We watch him boast of taking Venezuela’s president in an operation so fast and violent, threaten the vice president with worse, and name Colombia and Mexico next.

But the spell does not last. “The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?” We know who brings him down: first those he dealt with turn against him, and then Christ and his elect have the glory and honor of taking him down. The wicked are revealed and restrained for a time, a hedge around them until they fulfill what the Lord wants, and then comes their final judgment.

thread.text: And Zillah, she also bare Tubal–cain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron: and the sister of Tubal–cain was Naamah.

classes.title: Raising Cain: The Son of Perdition, Merchants, and Captive Nations

precepts.label: Genesis 27:38
precepts.why:
Tubal-cain was “an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron”. He worked metal, and at that time metal meant tools of war; he was not making decorations for your house. The mark followed Cain’s lineage: sin, violence and hatred were in his spirit. Where an artist sees art in raw material, his mind saw weapons. Weaponry came into the earth, or at least advanced, through Cain’s line. Murder led to industry, hatred led to technology, and violence led to institutional power, the hegemony that controls everything.

Then that spirit comes through Esau. “Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.” Isaac answered, “Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above”: he would have rulership and authority. And the connection to Tubal-cain: “And by thy sword shalt thou live”. The fatness of the earth, everything he has, he gets by violence.

Then: “and shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck”. That happened once our kingdom passed. We had a kingdom for a little while, and since then we have never been in any kind of power up to this day, while he increased through the process of time.

We see it in the graphic of Trump straddling the Western Hemisphere, the Monroe Doctrine renamed the Donroe Doctrine: this is mine. That is the one that sits upon many waters. The wicked are revealed, restrained for a time with a hedge around them to fulfill what the Lord wants, and then comes their final judgment.

precepts.label: Isaiah 54:16
precepts.why:
“Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work”. The Lord is over all of it. He puts it on Satan, his emissary, and Satan passes it around. It is twofold: it speaks of the brass and iron of Tubal-cain, and then it names something more.

Notice “an instrument”: not all weaponry, one in particular. Then he names it: “and I have created the waster to destroy”. What weapon at that time could have been called the waster? Nothing. Zechariah describes it: “Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet, and their eyes shall consume away in their holes, and their tongue shall consume away in their mouth.” Nobody could have imagined such a weapon then. They had no word for nuclear weapons or atoms, so they saw visions and explained them the best they could: it is the waster.

Malachi says, “behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven; and all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble”: Esau, the other nations, and rebellious Israel that does not repent. The day that cometh burns them so “it shall leave them neither root nor branch”. A fire leaves ash; this leaves nothing. Peter says “the elements shall melt with fervent heat”. The nations know it: their treaties against nuclear proliferation show the Lord staying their hand, because whoever uses one ends the world as they know it. Isaiah 29 says the strangers “shall be like small dust” and it shall be “at an instant suddenly”, not like regular fire, and all the nations that fight against Ariel, the lion of God, “even all that fight against her and her munition”, her weapons, “shall be as a dream of a night vision”, gone that quick. They filled their bellies and lived deliciously, and in an instant it is all gone. God put it in their spirit to make that thing, and he will use their own weapon, the thing that gave them their power and respect, to end them.

This should move us. The Lord “is longsuffering to us-ward”; the day waits until the set number is sealed, and it comes “as a thief in the night.” “Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness”? Paul says the same: “let us watch and be sober”: do not drink of her wine, do not sleep thinking you are an American and nothing can touch you. “For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ”. So “comfort yourselves together, and edify one another”: this is the time to be more united, not divided over simple issues. We look boldly for that day, because “we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness”: a baptism by fire that cleanses the evil and makes the earth fit for the kingdom.

thread.label: Genesis 4:23
thread.text: And Lamech said unto his wives, Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice; ye wives of Lamech, hearken unto my speech: for I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my hurt.

classes.title: Raising Cain: The Son of Perdition, Merchants, and Captive Nations

precepts.label: Genesis 27:41
precepts.why:
Lamech told his wives, “I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my hurt. If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.” That was cold-blooded murder, killing with no anger behind it, for the thrill of it. Cain killed in anger; if he is judged, how much more Lamech, who just had violence in him. He boasted in it. It went beyond Cain; it increased. That is when murder was normalized and celebrated in that line.

That is why Esau has the same spirit: “And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.” It is in his spirit till this day. Rebekah was told, “Behold, thy brother Esau, as touching thee, doth comfort himself, purposing to kill thee.” Killing is a comfort to him. Trump boasted that the Venezuela raid was very violent, and said of the boats, we are just going to kill them.

“Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; and arise, flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran”. The only thing Jacob could do was flee; he could not stand against that bloodthirsty violence. It is the same spirit as Cain: patient, vengeful and calculated. Cain lured his brother into the field; Esau said, I will wait until the days of mourning are done, and get him when he least suspects it.

That spirit is the son of perdition. “Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition; Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God”. It says revealed, not elected: he was ordained from the beginning. Ezra was told, “Jacob’s hand held first the heel of Esau. For Esau is the end of the world, and Jacob is the beginning of it that followeth.” People blame Jacob for grabbing the heel, but none of them had done good or evil in the womb; it was a sign, and Jacob was always supposed to be in rulership. Christ said, “those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.” He is not kept; he is ordained for destruction.

The Lord “shall destroy with the brightness of his coming” him “whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders”: the bomb, the weapons, the industrial complex and the economics. So it runs like a ring: Cain murdered his brother Abel, his line built weapons, Esau plotted to murder his brother Jacob, Isaiah 14 reveals the oppressor of the nations, and 2 Thessalonians shows the man of sin fully manifested in these last days. The spirit did not disappear; it evolved from individual murder, to weapon maker, to institutional violence, to global domination, a man who says nothing can stop him but his own morality. But “The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet” once he is laid down.

precepts.label: 1 John 3:1
precepts.why:
Genesis 5 traces the lineage from Adam down to Noah, who “begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.” Then Genesis 6 says “the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair.” The sons of God are that lineage just named; the daughters of men are the daughters of the other nations that were created. These are not literal angels. The chapter before gives the understanding, and the scriptures that follow prove who the sons of God are.

John writes it in the New Testament: “Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God.” That is what God calls us. Brothers, you are walking gods, whoever gets upset about it, the apologists included.

“therefore the world knoweth us not, because it knew him not.” The world looks at our people, calls us Negroes, and refuses to believe these could be the people of the book, the sons of God. And it knew him not: to this day they refuse to say Christ was a black man. They put the image of Cesare Borgia in every church, comic book and piece of media, while the Bible says he is black, of the tribe of Judah.

So when Genesis 6 speaks of “the sons of God” going in to the daughters of men, it is speaking of the same people John calls the sons of God: Adam’s line, our forefathers.

precepts.label: Psalms 82:6
precepts.why:
“the sons of God saw the daughters of men” in Genesis 6 is about men, not spirits; God says “My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh.” Psalms 82:6 shows who these sons of God are and what God calls them: “I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High.”

We are gods, and we are children of the Most High. That is why the sons of God in Genesis 6 are called by that name: they carried that DNA, made in the image of God.

It is also why their sin was so serious. Back in Genesis 6:4, “There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men.” The sons of God, the children of the Most High, took wives of the other nations, which was forbidden. The children born to them “became mighty men which were of old, men of renown,” and “God saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.” So the Most High brought destruction, and later we had to pay for what we did as the sons of God; he told Abraham his seed would be afflicted in a land not theirs for four hundred years.

precepts.label: Deuteronomy 14:1
precepts.why:
The sons of God in Genesis 6 are Adam’s line, the lineage traced in Genesis 5. Did that name change later, after the flood and after Egypt? No. Deuteronomy 14:1, spoken after the Exodus, says to Israel: “Ye are the children of the Lord your God.”

We are the children of the Lord our God because we are the sons of God. The same people carried the same title from Adam through Noah, through the fathers, out of Egypt, and into the law.

This matters for reading Genesis 6 rightly. The sons of God who went in to the daughters of men were not angels coming down from the sky; they were men of that same chosen line, God’s own children, who mixed with the other nations when it was forbidden. That sin brought the flood, and later the affliction of our people. The scriptures do not change the name: from Genesis, to Deuteronomy, to the prophets, to the New Testament, it is our people who are called the children and the sons of God.

precepts.label: Hosea 1:10
precepts.why:
The title “sons of God” runs through the whole book. After Deuteronomy called Israel “the children of the Lord your God,” did anything change in the prophets? No. Hosea 1:10: “Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered.”

“And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people.” That place is where our people are today: America and the diaspora, Jamaica, Haiti, Africa, Europe. Everywhere we were told we are not God’s people. “there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living God.”

God calls us the sons of the living God. That is who we are. So the sons of God of Genesis 6 are the same nation the prophet speaks of: the children of Israel, scattered and counted as nothing, yet still his sons. The world does not know us, but God does, and in the very place where we were called not his people, he will call us his sons again.

precepts.label: Judith 16:7
precepts.why:
Genesis 6:4 says the children of the sons of God and the daughters of men “became mighty men which were of old, men of renown,” and that “There were giants in the earth in those days.” Judith’s song names that kind of people: “For the mighty one did not fall by the young men, neither did the sons of the Titans smite him, nor high giants set upon him: but Judith the daughter of Merari weakened him with the beauty of her countenance.”

The sons of the Titans and the high giants are those giants, the men of renown of Genesis 6, the offspring of the sons of God.

That is where Esau gets his Titan movies, and his Greek mythology of Hercules and the half-gods. He always mixes some lies in with the truth. He tells those stories because he looks at us as gods: because of our DNA, our physical prowess, our melanin. We are the sons of God, demigods on the earth, and that is why when our people are put into sports or anything physical, we dominate. Everybody wants our rhythm, but nobody wants our blues.

So the Titans of the Greek stories are not fallen angels or gods of another people. They are a twisted memory of the mighty men born when the sons of God went in to the daughters of men.

precepts.label: Baruch 3:26-28
precepts.why:
Baruch says the same thing as Genesis 6: “There were the giants famous from the beginning, that were of so great stature, and so expert in war.” Those giants were the offspring of the sons of God, the mighty men of renown, and they were expert in war as well.

“Those did not the Lord choose, neither gave he the way of knowledge unto them.” God did not choose them; they were wicked. “But they were destroyed, because they had no wisdom, and perished through their own foolishness.” How were they destroyed? The flood. God saw that “every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually,” and he wiped it out.

But those same spirits came right back, by way of the three sons of Noah, Shem, Ham and Japheth. There is no new thing under the sun. Jude speaks of “certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation,” the same words, “of old,” that Genesis 6 uses of the men of renown. The same kind of wickedness is still here, reserved “unto the judgment of the great day,” which has not yet come.

So the giants are not a fantasy of fallen angels, the Nephilim Esau talks about. They were men, the offspring of the sons of God, who had no wisdom, and whose spirit lives on until the judgment.

precepts.label: Isaiah 41:14
precepts.why:
The Bible says God is a man of war. War is coming to this place; God is bringing war to the earth. And we should not be afraid of it. Isaiah 41: “For I the Lord thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee. Fear not, thou worm Jacob, and ye men of Israel; I will help thee, saith the Lord, and thy redeemer, the Holy One of Israel”. God is talking to us. Don't be afraid; he is going to help us.

Read on: “Behold, I will make thee a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth: thou shalt thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and shalt make the hills as chaff”. A new sharp threshing instrument is a weapon, a weapon of war. The mountains are the nations, and we are going to beat them small. “Thou shalt fan them, and the wind shall carry them away, and the whirlwind shall scatter them”. A time is coming when we will say, there was a place named America; what happened to it? It will be wiped out and never remembered again.

So when war comes, we should be celebrating, happy, not sad, because through those wars our salvation and our freedom come. We should pray for that thing. Our job now is to prepare for it, spiritually and mentally, not physically: prepare ourselves and our people, and keep a food pantry, as Bishop has been teaching for a while.

That preparing is spiritual warfare: “For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh”; the weapons of our warfare are “mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds”. Don't get caught up in the foolishness of this place, the marches and the stupidity, even with your own family. Stay in the scripture, cast down every evil imagination in the minds of our people, and bring every thought “to the obedience of Christ”, the black Messiah. The man of war fights for us.

precepts.label: Revelation 7:9
precepts.why:
“After this I beheld, and, lo, a great multitude, which no man could number, of all nations, and kindreds, and people, and tongues, stood before the throne, and before the Lamb”. Christians go to Revelation 7:9 to try to confuse you. They say all people coming out of all nations means all peoples, every race, standing before the throne.

But Moses already told us who would be found in all nations: “the Lord shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen”. That scattering was slavery, and we were left few in number because they were killing us. So a great multitude coming out of every nation and kindred and tongue is the scattered children of Israel, gathered back out of the lands they were taken to.

The precepts read right behind it settle it: Acts 2:5 shows Jews, devout men, “out of every nation under heaven”; Tobit 13 says “ye children of Israel: for he hath scattered us among them”; Ezekiel 28:25 speaks of the Lord gathering “the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered”; and James wrote “to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad”. The multitude before the throne is Israel out of every nation. If they confound you with Revelation 7:9 on the street, shame on you.

precepts.label: Acts 2:5
precepts.why:
“And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven.” This answers the question of who the people of all nations, kindreds and tongues are. They were Jews, Israelites, and they came out of every nation under heaven.

That is exactly what Moses prophesied in Deuteronomy 4: the Lord would scatter Israel among the nations. So when scripture shows a people coming out of every nation, it is not speaking of the nations themselves. It is speaking of Israel, found in every nation because the Lord scattered them there.

So Acts 2:5 is the key for Revelation 7:9. Out of every nation does not mean every nation's people; it means the devout Israelites dwelling among every nation, the same scattered people Deuteronomy 4:27 speaks of, who are seeking the Lord from thence.

precepts.label: Tobit 13:3-4
precepts.why:
“Confess him before the Gentiles, ye children of Israel: for he hath scattered us among them.” Tobit is speaking to the children of Israel, and he tells us plainly where they are: scattered among the Gentiles. The Lord did the scattering, just as Moses said in Deuteronomy 4:27.

“There declare his greatness, and extol him before all the living: for he is our Lord, and he is the God our Father for ever.” There, in those lands where we were scattered, declare his greatness. It is the same thing Moses said in Deuteronomy 4: “But if from thence thou shalt seek the Lord thy God, thou shalt find him”. From thence, from the lands we were taken to, we seek him, and we are seeking him now here in America and finding him.

So Tobit proves both halves of the opened scripture: Israel scattered among the Gentiles, and Israel turning to confess the Lord right there among them. He is our Lord, the God of our fathers for ever, and he has not forgotten the covenant of our fathers.

precepts.label: James 1:1
precepts.why:
“James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.” James wrote his letter to the twelve tribes, and he says where they are: scattered abroad. The scattering Moses prophesied in Deuteronomy 4:27 had already come upon them, and the apostles were writing to Israel in the nations.

It stands with Ezekiel 28:25, read in the same moment: “When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered, and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen, then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob.” Israel is scattered among the people, and the Lord gathers Israel out of them back to the land he gave Jacob.

So the great multitude out of all nations in Revelation 7:9 is the twelve tribes scattered abroad, gathered back. This is what you say when they try to tell you on the street that people coming out of all nations means all peoples. If you let them confound you with Revelation 7:9, shame on you.

precepts.label: 1 Kings 22:19-23
precepts.why:
In Job, “the sons of God came to present themselves before the Lord, and Satan came also among them. And the Lord said unto Satan, Whence comest thou?” But I thought he got kicked out of heaven and was one of the fallen ones? No. He is there because he works for God. God created good angels and bad angels, and Satan’s job is to tempt us; he is only allowed to do what God allows. The prophet Micaiah saw the same court of heaven.

“I saw the Lord sitting on his throne, and all the host of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left.” The angels on the right hand go forth for righteousness, and the ones on the left go forth for evil, for judgment.

“And the Lord said, Who shall persuade Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth–gilead?” One said one thing and another said another. “And there came forth a spirit, and stood before the Lord, and said, I will persuade him.” “I will go forth, and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And he said, Thou shalt persuade him, and prevail also: go forth, and do so.”

God gave that spirit the authority to do it, the same way he gave Satan the authority in Job 1 to tempt Job: destroy everything, but do not touch Job himself. Even the lying spirit stands before the throne and goes out only when the Lord sends it. That is why the fallen angel doctrine is crap, and why it is a shame to hear black pastors, not only Edomite pastors, repeating that same garbage rhetoric and defiling the minds of the people.

precepts.label: Psalms 103:20-22
precepts.why:
“Bless the Lord, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.” That do his commandments. I thought he kicked them out of heaven because they were disobedient and tried to overthrow him, and now they are fallen? No: they do his commandments. We just read about the spirit sent forth in 1 Kings 22, and about Satan working for the Most High in Job 1. The angels hearken unto the voice of the Most High.

“Bless ye the Lord, all ye his hosts; ye ministers of his, that do his pleasure.” Keep that word ministers in mind. They minister unto the Most High, doing his pleasure, and they also minister unto us.

“Bless the Lord, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the Lord, O my soul.” Every angel in every place of his dominion is under his rule, carrying out his commandments, which is why Satan could only go as far as the Lord allowed him with Job.

precepts.label: Hebrews 1:14
precepts.why:
The psalm calls the angels “ministers of his, that do his pleasure.” They minister unto the Most High, but they minister unto us as well: “Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?”

Who is going to be heir of salvation? Us, if we keep the commandments. So the angels work on our behalf. They are ministering spirits, sent forth by God for his people.

So the angels that come before the Lord in Job 1 are not rebels running loose. They are sent forth at his word, whether to try a man like Job or to minister for the heirs of salvation.

precepts.label: Ecclesiasticus 39:28-31
precepts.why:
This shows how the angels do what the Most High tells them. “There be spirits that are created for vengeance, which in their fury lay on sore strokes; in the time of destruction they pour out their force, and appease the wrath of him that made them.” Those are the angels on the left hand of God, and they minister unto God and to us.

“Fire, and hail, and famine, and death, all these were created for vengeance; Teeth of wild beasts, and scorpions, serpents, and the sword punishing the wicked to destruction.”

Here is the point: “They shall rejoice in his commandment, and they shall be ready upon earth, when need is; and when their time is come, they shall not transgress his word.” They do what God tells them to do. They do not have free will to say, let’s go down and sleep with some human women today. That is not what goes on in the heavens.

So when Satan went forth to touch all that Job had, he was doing what God allowed and no more. Even the spirits made for vengeance do not transgress his word.

precepts.label: Psalms 34:7
precepts.why:
The angels minister unto the Most High, and they minister unto us. “The angel of the Lord encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.” These are the good angels. They encamp around them that fear him and deliver them from all evil, like it says in the Lord’s prayer.

Our forefathers never looked at the angels as some demonic thing that came down to earth to persecute and kill them. When three men stood by Abraham in the plains of Mamre, he ran to meet them, bowed himself, had water fetched to wash their feet and prepared a calf for them to eat. When two angels came to Sodom, Lot rose up to meet them, bowed with his face to the ground and made them a feast, and they did eat. They look like us.

The angel in Revelation told John, I am thy fellow servant and of thy brethren; the angels have tribes too. Raphael presented the prayers of the saints. They are our brothers, working on our behalf. Calling them demons and fallen angels is Esau’s popular persuasion. The angel of the Lord camps round about them that fear God, just as the Lord set a hedge about Job, and delivers them.

The psalm says the wicked “shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves”. Their tongue is their media, how they speak through social media, and John shows how that tongue turns on them: “And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast, these shall hate the whore, and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.”

The ten horns is Europe. They are going to hate America. To make her “desolate” is to destroy this place. To make her “naked” is to expose her: your sins showing, your shame showing. A lot of the evil America and Europe did together is going to be exposed.

You see it happening today. Europe is saying you are wrong for what Israel did in Palestine, killing all these kids, and they brought charges against Netanyahu and put a warrant out for his arrest for war crimes. Whistleblowers are telling on each other. That is their own tongue falling upon themselves. That is why they want to take TikTok and X and control the warfare, but they are not going to be able to change nothing.

Job shows the same end for the wicked man: “The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; and the earth shall rise up against him.” The heaven revealing his iniquity starts with us: as we teach the word of God, the angels make things happen, Europe starts showing America's shame, and everybody sees the oppressor for what she is, and not just America but Israel too. Then “a fire not blown shall consume him”: a fire you do not have to fan, the nuclear bomb, and “it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle”, left here in America.

The earth that rises up against him is the nations. Isaiah shows it: “Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming”, hell being that low condition everybody on the earth is in, and “it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.” “How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning!” How are you fallen from ruling, O America. All nations rise up to fight against America and destroy her.

So leave social media alone. It was created to monitor you, brainwash you and control you. God is going to save the poor from their mouth, and their own tongue will bring them down.

precepts.label: Micah 2:1
precepts.why:
“Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?” They do not abandon the law; they weaponise it. They wrote the laws, so they know how to get around them. The most powerful pen in the world, with a stack of bills beside it, is the president of the United States, and every nation bends the knee. Violence gets reframed legally in their decrees and doctrines: kidnapping becomes a law enforcement operation, sanctions become international order, theft becomes stabilising the region. When he promised to lock up the criminal illegal immigrants, you thought thieves and murderers; but by their law, anyone here without papers is a criminal. That is framing mischief by a law.

Micah shows how they work: “Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.” When the morning is light means in broad daylight, because they can frame it by law, and he says his own morality is the only limit. It is in the power of their hand because they are after the working of Satan, given authority to set kings up and take them down.

“And they covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.” It is not just the resources; they want the identity too. The ADL says it has analysts monitoring 24 hours a day and trains law enforcement, and in Patagonia Israeli tourists were caught setting fires in a protected preserve they cannot buy unless it is damaged. Their eye is on the land and on the lost tribes. They practise it in the light, because it is in the power of their hand.

precepts.label: 1 Maccabees 1:11
precepts.why:
“Though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished.” The hands joined together are the black pastors holding hands with Amalek, encouraging the African-American churches to defend Israel, and even naming the Hebrew Israelites in their articles. The white man is not worried about them; they do not know the Bible and they teach heresies.

Maccabees shows this is nothing new: “In those days went there out of Israel wicked men, who persuaded many, saying, Let us go and make a covenant with the heathen that are round about us: for since we departed from them we have had much sorrow.” And “So this device pleased them well.”

Amongst our people there are wicked men, and they persuaded many. Let us make a covenant with the Greeks, with the white man. We have always had certain men among us who are wicked, who made covenants and agreements with the white man.

So the black pastors joining hands with the fake Israelis are the same wicked men of Maccabees, and the Most High says they shall not be unpunished. But the seed of the righteous, the twelve tribes of Israel, shall be delivered.

precepts.label: Isaiah 28:15-20
precepts.why:
The wicked join hand in hand by covenant, and Isaiah names that covenant: “Because ye have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us: for we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves.” That is the black pastors and politicians.

“Therefore thus saith the Lord God, Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone, a sure foundation.” This is Christ. “he that believeth shall not make haste”: you will not be confounded; you will not leave this truth.

“Judgment also will I lay to the line, and righteousness to the plummet: and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies.” The Lord is bringing judgment. The hail, the destruction, shall sweep away the refuge of Christianity and all its lies, and Islam as well. “And your covenant with death shall be disannulled, and your agreement with hell shall not stand.” All the blacks that made a covenant with the white man, with these fake Israelis, shall have it disannulled; the agreement with hell is this low condition our people are in. “when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, then ye shall be trodden down by it”: those black pastors shall be trodden down.

“From the time that it goeth forth it shall take you”: from the time the teaching goes forth. “for morning by morning shall it pass over, by day and by night: and it shall be a vexation only to understand the report.” Morning by morning, day and night, you are going to hear the proper teaching, and it vexes you, because you already made that agreement for the financial gain.

“For the bed is shorter than that a man can stretch himself on it: and the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself in it.” Whether you are in Christianity or politics, you are trying to get comfortable after hearing the vexing report. You know it is true, but you made that agreement. The bed is your lies and there is not enough room; you try to wrap yourself in your Christian lies, but you already heard the report. That is why the wicked, hand in hand, shall not be unpunished.

precepts.label: Ephesians 2:20
precepts.why:
The wicked join hands in a covenant with death, but the righteous have another foundation. Isaiah says, “Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone, a sure foundation”, and that stone is Christ.

Ephesians proves it: “And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone; In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord.” Christ is the chief corner stone. We are built upon Christ and the holy apostles.

That is the difference between the two sides of Proverbs 11:21. The black pastors and politicians built on lies, their refuge of lies that the hail will sweep away. The seed of the righteous is built on the tried stone, and “he that believeth shall not make haste”: he will not be confounded and will not leave this truth. That is why the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.

precepts.label: Zechariah 11:5
precepts.why:
Latino and black pastors join hands to support Babylon and not God, not the Most High. Zechariah shows what those they join with have done to us: “Whose possessors slay them, and hold themselves not guilty: and they that sell them say, Blessed be the Lord; for I am rich: and their own shepherds pity them not.”

The ones that possess us now are the white man, and he slays us: Rasheem Carter, Kendrick Johnson, Breonna Taylor, Philando Castile, Sandra Bland, George Floyd. We found out they were hunting us on Epstein’s island. And they hold themselves not guilty.

“and they that sell them say, Blessed be the Lord; for I am rich.” They got rich from selling us into slavery. The majority of the wealth America has came from four hundred years of free chattel slavery.

“and their own shepherds pity them not.” Our own shepherds are our pastors and our congressmen and women. They pity us not because they are getting a piece of the American pie. They do not give a damn about our brothers and sisters being shot down in the street, about Rasheem Carter, about Kendrick Johnson, whose case was dismissed again though he had taser marks and cut marks and the school footage disappeared.

Those shepherds are the wicked joined hand in hand with our possessors, and they shall not be unpunished.

precepts.label: Luke 22:48
precepts.why:
“Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.” The last part is the point: the kisses of an enemy are deceitful. And Luke shows the kiss: “Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?” Judas betrayed Christ with a kiss. The man betrayed him with the very sign of love.

Today we do not greet each other with a kiss like that, but we have our own greeting: Shalom, Captain, Most High bless. That is the betrayal. The embrace, the salute, the Shalom, and then the knife. That is the kiss of an enemy.

We saw it in 2018. A man who had been in another man’s house, greeting him with Shalom, barbecuing together, traveling together, came to that same man’s house, took all his furniture and put his children on the cold floor to sleep. He did not care. Not only did he betray the man, he betrayed all his children.

There is nothing worse than a traitor. And some of you think once you betray your brother or your sister, that is the end of it. It is not. The one who betrays with a kiss will be dealt with too. That is why the kisses of an enemy are called deceitful: Judas is the pattern of the familiar hand that destroys.

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 15:28-30
precepts.why:
Isaiah says, “Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it.” Before the 70s Iran was always known as Persia; that is the Medes and Persians, the second of Daniel's beasts counting from Babylon. God is going to stir them up against the United States of America, Babylon, and all the bombs, the warfare and the destroying of their economy that America and Israel are doing is what will make them rise up. They will not care about money or gold.

“Their bows also shall dash the young men to pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not spare children.” They will even kill children. That is the third woe: it starts in the land of Israel and ends with America destroyed. “And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms” … “shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.” That is nuclear destruction.

Ezra shows who sets it off: “Behold an horrible vision, and the appearance thereof from the east: Where the nations of the dragons of Arabia shall come out with many chariots, and the multitude of them shall be carried as the wind upon earth, that all they which hear them may fear and tremble.” The dragons of Arabia are the Arabs, the sons of Ishmael. They are the ones who will fully set it off, with the Israelis in the land over there. It will not be Iran first.

“Also the Carmanians raging in wrath shall go forth as the wild boars of the wood.” The Carmanians are Iran, the Persians. Why are they raging in wrath? Because of all the oppression, the sanctions, the bombing of their cities, the killing of their leaders. In the following years Iran will be under heavy sanctions and bombed a lot by the United States, and America and Israel are trying to back a coup against the Iranian regime. Everything Trump is doing is just fulfilling Bible prophecy: he is making the Persians mad.

We don't give a crap about the Arabs or the Iranians. Those people enslaved us, and God is bringing judgment on them. America is the hammer of God, and God is using America to judge the Arabs and the Persians. Then in the end that same cup America is pouring on them is going to be poured on America.

America is about to turn up affliction on everyone on this earth, including us, and it will get worse and worse, like a woman in travail. So this is not the time to be in la-la land or in the midst of sin. It is the time to prepare ourselves and get our spirit right for what is about to take place.

precepts.label: Revelation 18:10
precepts.why:
“That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!” In the day the Lord gives us rest from our sorrow, our fear and the hard bondage we were made to serve in, we are going to be speaking against America. The king of Babylon here is America, and this is how we know Lucifer is not an angel: Lucifer is called the king of Babylon, the oppressor, the golden city. In Revelation it is mystery Babylon the great, and Revelation 18 explains that city.

“Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.” Remember what we read in Isaiah 14: the king of Babylon. Here it is that great city Babylon, that mighty city, and her judgment comes in one hour.

So Lucifer is a city, a country, rulers, a government. “The Lord hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers.” It is not talking about a fallen angel; it is talking about America, the king of Babylon, whose ceasing Israel will proclaim when the Lord gives us rest from the hard bondage.

precepts.label: Revelation 18:17
precepts.why:
Isaiah calls the king of Babylon “the golden city”: “How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!” Why does it say golden city? Revelation 18 explains it: “For in one hour so great riches is come to nought.”

So great riches: that is the golden city. It is called golden because America is rich. Lucifer is talking about America. And all those riches come to nothing in one hour, the same hour of judgment in verse 10, when they stand afar off crying, “Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city!”

The golden city ceasing in Isaiah is the great riches coming to nought in Revelation. It is not an angel that falls; it is a rich nation, a government, the oppressor that made us serve in hard bondage, and in the day the Lord gives us rest, we will take up this proverb against it.

precepts.label: Matthew 8:28-33
precepts.why:
Isaiah says of the king of Babylon, “Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming: it stirreth up the dead for thee, even all the chief ones of the earth”. Babylon is the United States of America, and hell is the destiny of its prideful rulers. Hell is a condition, and it is also a real place of torment and suffering. People say, you have nothing, you just walk around in purple clothes talking about the Bible. We know something you don't know: your ass is going to hell. Hell is a real place, and you're going there. We would not trade places with them for all the tea in China, for all the gold in Fort Knox.

Some Israelite camps teach there is no place of torment, and every time we teach about hell they make counter videos. So look at what the devils said to Christ. In the country of the Gergesenes “there met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way.” “And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?”

The demons recognized Christ, and they knew there is a time appointed for torment. Then “the devils besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.” An evil spirit needs a vessel to inhabit. “And he said unto them, Go.” The whole herd “ran violently down a steep place into the sea, and perished in the waters.” The Lord has a place where evil spirits go to suffer torment.

There is a time appointed when everybody who is evil, Israelite or not, is going to pay. Do not let any camp make you think you will escape judgment; they have no scripture to paint that picture.

Why would God make such a place? Because there are people on this earth who do not care about death, prison or you; they will do the most depraved things and laugh about it on the way to the grave. There has to be an extreme punishment for people who disregard life. If there were no hell and no place of suffering, God would not be feared. So there is a hell, God has it prepared, and the wicked, including wicked Israelites, are going into it.

precepts.label: Romans 11:1-2, 25-26
precepts.why:
Some Israelite camps use “all Israel shall be saved” to argue that even the wicked will escape hell. To see what Paul meant, start from the beginning of the chapter: “I say then, Hath God cast away his people? God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.”

Why did Paul open that way? Because of the conflict between the northern and southern kingdoms. The Jews thought God was not dealing with the northern kingdom anymore, since God had told them, you are not my people, and Hosea said that where it was said unto them, you are not my people, there they would be called the children of the living God. Paul, of Benjamin, was of the southern kingdom, and he answers, “God hath not cast away his people which he foreknew.”

“For I would not, brethren, that ye should be ignorant of this mystery, lest ye should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Israel, until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in.” The mystery is that God is dealing with both the northern and southern kingdoms, which is why the chapter talks about them being grafted back in. God blinded a portion, the Jews, to salvation in Jesus Christ so that the gospel could be preached to the northern kingdom living as Gentiles, so they could come in. If you say you're an Israelite and you still don't understand this chapter after all these years, you're an idiot, and God is not dealing with you.

“And so all Israel shall be saved”. That means both kingdoms, all twelve tribes, can be saved. It is not a license saying a murderer, an adulterer or a thief will be saved at the end no matter what. You see how stupid they are? Leaders who use this verse to say you are not going to hell are wise in their own conceits. There is a hell, and if you go against God you are going into it, Israelite or not.

precepts.label: Genesis 27:39-40
precepts.why:
Isaiah describes the king of Babylon as “He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke, he that ruled the nations in anger”. That is how they got where they are: they took this land with bloodshed, massacred the indigenous people, dragged Negroes to America against their will for hundreds of years and used us for free labor, and they are still always looking for a reason to start a war.

Isaac told Esau where that comes from: “Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above;” “And by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.”

Esau was given the fatness of the earth, and he lives by the sword. That is why they do not want anybody else to have a weapon. A nuclear weapon is a sword, and they rule because they can kill and destroy anything that comes against them. It is why they go to war with Iran over nuclear capability they have been talking about for thirty years, even when their own officials ask why.

It is also why the Pope calling for peace gets called weak. For a people who live by the sword, peace looks like weakness. But the same chapter of Isaiah says the one who weakened the nations will be cut down to the ground, because the pride of his heart has deceived him.

precepts.label: Lamentations 2:1
precepts.why:
“How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground.” Who is Lucifer, and what heaven did he fall from? When it says fall from heaven, it is not talking about literal heaven. In the scriptures there are the heavens where the Lord is, which is paradise; there is heaven that is the sky and space; and there are heavens that are a place of authority. Lamentations shows that last one.

“How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger, and cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel.” The beauty of Israel was cast down from heaven to the earth. That means we were brought down low: brought into captivity, no longer on top, no longer ruling. It is a good analogy showing that heaven also goes into rulership.

So Lucifer falling from heaven is a ruler falling from his place of authority, not an angel falling out of the sky. Read on in Isaiah 14 and he is named: Israel will “take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!” Lucifer is the king of Babylon, the oppressor, the golden city, because America is rich. And “They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms”: Lucifer is a man, the man of sin, the fourth beast, the white man.

The same Lord who cast Israel down from heaven to the earth will cut this ruler down to the ground. It is a future prophecy of America being destroyed.

thread.label: Isaiah 14:12-16
thread.text: How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!

classes.title: Popular Persuasions: Fighting Against Heaven Defending Earth

precepts.label: Lamentations 2:1
precepts.why:
“How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer”: before we can know who Lucifer is, we have to know what heaven is. Lamentations shows it: “How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger, and cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel.”

Heaven is dominion and rulership. That was the high standard, the high estate Israel held, and the beauty of Israel was cast down from it to the earth. We were set down to a low state. No one thinks Israel was literally thrown out of the sky; we fell from rulership.

So it is with Lucifer. Esau takes Jude and Isaiah 14, mixes them up and comes with this fallen angel teaching. But keep it in context. Lucifer, the lightbearer, is the king of Babylon of verse 4, the oppressor, the one who “smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke.” It is talking about a nation: this so-called white man, America, whom everybody looks at as god and all knowing because he controls communication everywhere.

He is falling from heaven the same way Israel did: he is losing his dominion and his rulership. “They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble”: not a fallen angel, not the Nephilim, but the man, the one who made the earth tremble by dropping atom bombs everywhere. The angels are not falling out of heaven; they take their directive from the Most High God.

precepts.label: Daniel 7:27
precepts.why:
Daniel shows again what heaven means: “And the kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the saints of the most High.” That is rulership. Still on the third temple: “And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given unto them”. Power was given unto them.

Then: “and I saw the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Jesus, and for the word of God”: the martyred. Then: “and which had not worshipped the beast, neither his image, neither had received his mark upon their foreheads, or in their hands”: the mark of sin, that lets you know it is somebody in these last days, who would not support the beast.

Then: “and they lived and reigned with Christ a thousand years”. Notice the top of it: thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given unto them. This is the third temple being built up. We are going to reign with Christ for a thousand years.

That is why Isaiah 60 ends with the ones who afflicted us bowing: “all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet; and they shall call thee, The city of the Lord, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.” It is the same thing Revelation 3:9 said. The third temple is under Christ, not what the Christians make of Daniel 9.

precepts.label: Revelation 21:24-27
precepts.why:
“And the nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light of it: and the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honour into it.” Saved here does not mean what people get confused about. It means left over: “every one that is left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem”. Those that are left walk in the light of it: they obey the commandments, and come up to worship the King of kings and keep the feast of tabernacles.

“And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day: for there shall be no night there.” That is the third temple, the same gates of Isaiah 60: “thy gates shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that men may bring unto thee the forces of the Gentiles, and that their kings may be brought.” Forces means wealth, and their kings are brought in chains. “For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish”.

“And they shall bring the glory and honour of the nations into it. And there shall in no wise enter into it any thing that defileth, neither whatsoever worketh abomination, or maketh a lie: but they which are written in the Lamb’s book of life.” So the nations themselves are not walking in. They are bringing their glory and honour up to the men of God at the gates. Those written in the Lamb's book of life are the Israelites. Only the Israelites get in.

precepts.label: Zechariah 14:16
precepts.why:
When Revelation says “the nations of them which are saved”, Zechariah gives the thought: “And it shall come to pass, that every one that is left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem shall even go up from year to year to worship the King, the Lord of hosts, and to keep the feast of tabernacles.”

Everyone that is left. Christ is not killing everybody. There are going to be remnants of people left over from the nations that came against Jerusalem. Those are the “saved” of Revelation 21: the ones left.

And what they do is go up every year to worship the King and keep the feast of tabernacles. That is walking in the light of it: obeying the commandments. That is how the nations serve in Isaiah 60, bringing their wealth and their kings to the gates while Israel is inside. “For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish; yea, those nations shall be utterly wasted.”

precepts.label: 2 Thessalonians 2:4
precepts.why:
If they want to use any scripture about a third temple, this is where you go. If they build that temple, this is what we are going to use: “Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.”

Who is that? The white man, who opposes everything the Bible says. Before 70 AD, before they destroyed it, Rome entered our temple and sat their rusty butt down. And after Titus destroyed Jerusalem, Rome built Aelia Capitolina on its ruins, named for the emperor Hadrian, whose clan name was Aelius, and for Jupiter, Juno and Minerva: that is the trinity, where Christianity got that doctrine. A sanctuary to Jupiter, that is Zeus, the devil, was built on the Temple Mount, statues of Roman gods were set up in intentional violation of Old Testament law, and the real Jews were forbidden the city. The walls of the old city today follow the Roman walls: the wailing wall they hump on nowadays.

Now they are trying to build on the Temple Mount again. If the Lord allows them to be successful, one will sit there saying I am God, and everybody will cheer. No. That is the man Paul warned of.

The true third temple is the one in Isaiah 60, under Christ: the strangers build its walls, the nations bring their wealth to its gates, and those who despised us bow at the soles of our feet and call it “The city of the Lord, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.”

precepts.why:
Jeremiah says the prophets of old “prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.” All the prophets made sure to speak of these things. It is bad news for everybody else but good news for Israel, because when we see these signs we see the time hastening for the Lord's people, his heritage. They are not uncertain; they are an assurance and an establishment of our faith. This is not a time to prophesy peace in the earth. The peace is among us: the middle wall of partition broken down between the northern and southern kingdom, no more alienation from Christ, his laws and our identity.

Isaiah tells us where to see it: “Seek ye out of the book of the Lord, and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate”. We must read and understand so we can see these things. Too many of our people, even those repenting, are caught up in other things and do not think what is happening warrants their attention. Go back and read your scriptures more. The warnings and the shortening of days are there to put a fire under us so we seek out our own salvation with fear and trembling.

No other book gives this understanding. It has survived countless attempts to burn, destroy and alter it, and Christianity minimizes it to a book of love, hugs and kisses. That is a slap in the face, because most of the book is doom, destruction, war, judgment and recompense, and the people waiting on prophecy are always the oppressed.

“for my mouth it hath commanded, and his spirit it hath gathered them.” Christ's spirit gathered these things together so they would be plain to those who keep the commandments and be preserved for us to use in these last days. None of the prophecies of war, evil and pestilence will fail.

precepts.label: Joel 3:1
precepts.why:
The Lord told Jeremiah, “Write thee all the words that I have spoken unto thee in a book”: the Bible. “For, lo, the days come, saith the Lord, that I will bring again the captivity of my people Israel and Judah”.

Joel uses the same words: “For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem”. Sometimes in your thoughts you might be saying that means the Lord is going to make us slaves again. No, that is not what it means.

Jeremiah explains it in the same verse: “and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.” To bring again the captivity is to bring us again to our land. That is the evidence. The same phrase in Joel 3:1 speaks of that same return of Judah and Jerusalem, in those days and in that time, the days of Jacob's trouble, out of which he shall be saved.

precepts.label: Matthew 10:22-23
precepts.why:
“Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it: it is even the time of Jacob’s trouble; but he shall be saved out of it.” That is the great tribulation. Jeremiah does not go into much detail on how he is saved out of it, so Christ fills it in.

“And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved.” Christ prophesied we would be hated of all men for his sake, so we have to endure the hatred. Brothers and sisters on TikTok, YouTube and Instagram ask why the white man hates us so much. Because we are the sons and daughters of God, the people of Christ.

“But when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another”. So when you brothers go to these other countries, check out the real estate, find out whether you can get citizenship or residency, question and research, because if something pops off here we have to be able to move. One city may pop off and the next city may not have the same persecution.

“for verily I say unto you, Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come.” We will not have reached all the twelve tribes before Christ comes; we are not going to reach every Israelite. Christ says the same in Matthew 24: they shall deliver you up to be afflicted and kill you, many shall be offended and betray one another, but he that endures unto the end, either your death or Christ's return, shall be saved.

precepts.label: Isaiah 66:19-21
precepts.why:
How do we know we will not reach all the Israelites everywhere before Christ comes? Isaiah shows the rest are gathered after: “And I will set a sign among them, and I will send those that escape of them unto the nations”. Those that escape are the 144,000.

They are sent “to Tarshish”, Spain, “Pul”, Libya, “and Lud”, Lydia, “that draw the bow, to Tubal”, Turkey, “and Javan”, Greece, “to the isles afar off”, like the Melanesian isles. When we went to Papua New Guinea and looked at the map, there are thousands of islands there. These are places “that have not heard my fame, neither have seen my glory”: they have not heard the gospel. “and they shall declare my glory among the Gentiles.” The 144,000 collect the Israelites that are in these other nations.

“And they shall bring all your brethren for an offering unto the Lord out of all nations upon horses, and in chariots, and in litters, and upon mules, and upon swift beasts, to my holy mountain Jerusalem”. The kingdom is already set up at this time, and the third temple is built.

“And I will also take of them for priests and for Levites, saith the Lord.” The brothers and sisters gathered from among those nations, the Lord will make those men priests and Levites. That is how Jacob is saved out of his trouble and all Israel is brought again to the land.

precepts.label: Daniel 7:19-20
precepts.why:
Daniel asks to know “the truth of the fourth beast, which was diverse from all the others, exceeding dreadful, whose teeth were of iron, and his nails of brass”. The fourth beast is the fourth kingdom to rise up and rule the earth: it began with Rome, and Europe and America are the extension of Rome. The beast is Edom, the so-called white man.

“And of the ten horns that were in his head, and of the other which came up, and before whom three fell”. The ten horns are the Europeans; when the European Union was first formed it was ten nations, though today it is much more than that. The other horn that came up among them is America, and the three that fell before it are the powers America fought for its independence: France, Spain and Britain. This year America turns 250 years old.

“even of that horn that had eyes, and a mouth that spake very great things”. Look at the back of the dollar bill: the eye of a man set in the top of the pyramid, separated from the rest of it so it looks like a horn, with light illuminating all around it. It is not only the eye of Ra; they put the eyes of a man there. Those eyes are this man's wisdom and his technology, the wisdom Satan gave him. And it is his claim to be God: God sees everything everyone does, and the white man sets himself up as God and says, I see everything.

The great mouth speaks great things: he calls himself the people of God, calls himself a Jew, and says the land of Israel belongs to him. America has spoken many great things against God. And the great mouth is his power to communicate, to speak from one side of the world to the other.

“whose look was more stout than his fellows”: America is stronger than all the European nations. Why? Because of the technology, because of that great mouth and those eyes. Ezekiel shows the same wisdom in the prince of Tyrus, a rich ancient city on the coast of Lebanon that God uses as an analogy for America: “thou hast said, I am a God, I sit in the seat of God”, “yet thou art a man, and not God”. “Behold, thou art wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that they can hide from thee”. With the technology we have, you can talk to someone on the other side of the world and see him on a device. There is no secret you can hide from the white man; every evil you do, everything you buy, he sees it.

“By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches”: that is how America became rich, through its technology and trade, the system that made the American dollar the dominant dollar in the world. But because he has set his heart “as the heart of God”, God says, “I will bring strangers upon thee, the terrible of the nations: and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom”. That is future prophecy.
