precepts.label: Revelation 12:12
precepts.why:
“And in the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors are come to the full, a king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up.” A leader, a system of fierce countenance, which understands dark sentences, scriptural texts, to a degree. John shows the same thing in Revelation 12:12.

“Therefore rejoice, ye heavens, and ye that dwell in them.” That is not the sky; the sky doesn't go woo. It is men living in dominion, in rulership: Edom today, America, Germany, France, Great Britain, Australia, Canada. Those are the heavens, and those that dwell in them.

“Woe to the inhabiters of the earth and of the sea!” Woe means destruction. The earth is the third world countries, like the continent of Africa. The sea is the islands: Puerto Rico, Santo Domingo, Haiti, Jamaica, the Melanesian islands. If you do not live in the heavens, if you are beneath them, woe to you.

“for the devil is come down unto you, having great wrath, because he knoweth that he hath but a short time.” The devil lives in the heavens, and his time is almost up. That is the parallel between what Daniel said and what John said: the king of fierce countenance who stands up in the latter time is the same devil who rules from the heavens with great wrath.

precepts.label: Isaiah 34:5
precepts.why:
Who is in the heaven that is going to rejoice? Isaiah 34:5: “For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.”

Christ's sword shall be bathed in heaven and come down upon heaven. Look up Idumea: pertaining to Edom, the Greek and Roman name for Edom. That is what the heavens are. Edom today is America, Germany, France, Great Britain, Australia, Canada.

Don't let anybody tell you Edom was already destroyed. If he were, then who is Christ coming back to kill here in Isaiah 34? The people of his curse are still standing in the heavens, and that is why Daniel's king of fierce countenance “shall be broken without hand” in the last kingdom.

precepts.label: Revelation 13:2-7
precepts.why:
“And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power.” What does that mean? Revelation 13: “And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard”, like the Greeks, “and his feet were as the feet of a bear”, like the Medes and Persians, “and his mouth as the mouth of a lion”, similar to Babylon, “and the dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority.”

That dragon is Satan. They say God bless America, but no: Satan gave them their power. That is why Satan said to Christ that if he would bow down and worship him, he would give him all the glory and kingdoms of the world, for that was given to him to give to whomsoever he desired.

Then Daniel says he “shall destroy the mighty and the holy people”: the twelve tribes of Israel. This man destroyed us. Revelation 13:7 says it too: “And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them.” The same man who stands up in the last days made war with the saints, and the saints are the twelve tribes of Israel. They overcame us and destroyed us. “and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations”: he ruled everybody.

precepts.label: Deuteronomy 28:48
precepts.why:
Daniel says the king of fierce countenance “shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.” Haven't we been destroyed? We have been destroyed as a people. Watch the wording of Deuteronomy 28:48.

“Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee.” The Lord sent Europe against us; the Lord sent America against us. “in hunger”: for food. “and in thirst”: for water. “and in nakedness”: for clothing. “and in want of all things”: if you want anything, you have to go to your enemies. If you want education, go to your enemies. If you want to learn about God, you have to go to your enemies.

“and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” Here is the part we want: until he have destroyed us. The yokes of iron have been taken off. What does that prove? That we have been destroyed, exactly what Daniel 8:24 says.

And Daniel goes on: “by peace shall destroy many.” Donald Trump calls himself the president of peace and set up a board of peace, yet he has bombed Yemen, Somalia, Iraq, Iran, Syria, Nigeria and Venezuela. We are living in that time right now.

thread.label: Daniel 9:24-27
thread.text: Seventy weeks are determined upon thy people and upon thy holy city, to finish the transgression, and to make an end of sins, and to make reconciliation for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to sea

classes.title: Prophesy From Pain to Peace

precepts.label: Numbers 14:34
precepts.why:
Edom twists Daniel 9, so here is the code to break it down. Write it down: each day represents one year, each week represents seven years, and seventy weeks is 490 years. How do we know? Start with why Israel spent forty years in the wilderness.

“After the number of the days in which ye searched the land, even forty days, each day for a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, even forty years”. The spies searched the land forty days. Because Israel sinned, they bore their iniquity forty years in the wilderness, a year for every day. “and ye shall know my breach of promise”: the Lord told them not to go up there, and they went up anyway.

That is the Lord himself counting a day for a year. So when Daniel is told “Seventy weeks are determined upon thy people and upon thy holy city”, those weeks are counted the same way: seventy weeks of seven days, every day a year, 490 years.

precepts.label: Ezekiel 4:6
precepts.why:
The Lord gives the same count a second time, to Ezekiel: “thou shalt bear the iniquity of the house of Judah forty days: I have appointed thee each day for a year.” Each day for a year. With Numbers 14 that is two witnesses to the code: a day in prophecy is a year.

Now Daniel 9 opens up. “Seventy weeks are determined upon thy people”: seventy weeks equals 490 years. “from the going forth of the commandment to restore and to build Jerusalem unto the Messiah the Prince shall be seven weeks, and threescore and two weeks”: seven weeks plus sixty-two weeks is sixty-nine weeks, 483 years. That commandment started with Cyrus, when God told the Persians to let his people go to rebuild; Israel was hindered two years, then came Darius and Artaxerxes, and the building went on under Zerubbabel, Joshua, Ezra and Nehemiah, with Haggai and Zechariah. “the street shall be built again, and the wall, even in troublous times”: our forefathers caught hell from the nations and built with a sword in one hand and a brick in the other.

“after threescore and two weeks shall Messiah be cut off, but not for himself”: Christ crucified, not dying for himself but for the twelve tribes of Israel. “the people of the prince that shall come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary”: Rome, in 70 AD. Then the last week: “he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week: and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease”, and “for the overspreading of abominations he shall make it desolate”, the abomination in the temple Christ warned about.

The total of seventy weeks has been fulfilled. Amalek tells Christians that last week has not happened yet and belongs to a rebuilt temple today, counting on blacks and Latinos not understanding the scriptures and going along with whatever they say because they are white. Counted a day for a year, the way the Lord counts it, all seventy weeks are done.

precepts.label: Acts 10:38
precepts.why:
Seventy weeks are determined “to finish the transgression, and to make an end of sins, and to make reconciliation for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal up the vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most Holy.” To make an end of sins is Christ coming to die, and the reconciliation for iniquity is all through Christ.

And who is the most Holy that is anointed? “How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him.” Christ is the anointed one.

So the bottom of Daniel 9:24, “to anoint the most Holy”, is Christ, anointed as the most Holy. That is why the seventy weeks run unto “the Messiah the Prince”: the whole prophecy is counted to him and fulfilled in him.

thread.label: Daniel 11:14
thread.text: And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south: also the robbers of thy people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision; but they shall fall.

classes.title: Prophesy From Pain to Peace

precepts.label: 1 Maccabees 3:48
precepts.why:
The robbers of thy people did not start with the Herodians. When the Greeks started to conquer us, look what they did: “And laid open the book of the law, wherein the heathen had sought to paint the likeness of their images.”

The book of the law is the Bible. Daniel wrote during the time of Babylon; after that came the Persians and the Medes, and then the Greeks. Even from the time of the Greeks the heathen started to paint their images in our book and say that they are Moses, they are Joshua, they are Samson.

That is the same spirit as Daniel 11:14: “the robbers of thy people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision”. First they painted themselves into our book as our fathers. Then the Herodians, Herod and Agrippa, robbed our culture and our heritage and became Jews in the time of Christ. And in 1948 they got the land again, set up schools throughout Israel and taught a new form of Hebrew, a Hebrew that was extinct from 70 AD and made up by fusing French, Arabic, Aramaic, Spanish and German words, which Negroes argue about today. They got the land, made up a new language, and called themselves Jewish. But the prophecy says, “they shall fall.”

precepts.label: Job 9:24
precepts.why:
This is them establishing the vision that they are the Jews. “The earth is given into the hand of the wicked”: the wicked rule the earth, God says.

“he covereth the faces of the judges thereof”. The judges are God, Christ, the angels, and the Israelites, the Jews. He covers all their faces with his own: he puts his images everywhere as the people of God. “if not, where, and who is he?”

That is how the robbers of thy people exalt themselves to establish the vision. They are the ones ruling the earth, so they cover the faces of God's people with their own and put themselves in the place of the Jews, the same way they painted their likeness into the book of the law. And Daniel says of them, “but they shall fall.”

precepts.label: Job 24:15
precepts.why:
This one is rarely read, but it says the same thing as Job 9:24. “The eye also of the adulterer”: that is this white man; he is the adulterer. He rapes and robs and pillages women. That's what they do.

“waiteth for the twilight, saying, No eye shall see me: and disguiseth his face.” He disguises his face as the Jews. He disguises his face as Jesus. He disguises his face as the angels. And everybody goes, no, nobody could believe that this man did all this.

So the robbers of thy people in Daniel 11:14 establish the vision in disguise. They exalt themselves as the Jews wearing a face that is not theirs, thinking no eye shall see them, and that is why the world cannot believe what they have done.

precepts.label: Ezekiel 35:12-15
precepts.why:
Here God shows what those robbers said when they took the land. “I have heard all thy blasphemies which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to consume.” They said, the real Jews are gone, the Israelites are finished, the land is ours now. “Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard them.” God said, I have heard them.

“When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate.” That is when they shall say peace and safety. “As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate”: they rejoiced over the land because the twelve tribes were gone and put in captivity. “so will I do unto thee: thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Idumea, even all of it”.

Idumea is the Greek and Roman name for Edom. It does not say some of Idumea; it says all Idumea, even all of it. That is who the robbers of thy people are: Edom, which is Amalek over there, set themselves up as the Jews. Their plan is to make believe Iran shot a missile and blew up the Al-Aqsa Mosque so they can rebuild the third temple. But when the whole earth rejoices, God makes them desolate: “but they shall fall.”

precepts.label: Ezekiel 36:5
precepts.why:
“Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen, and against all Idumea, which have appointed my land into their possession”. This verse, along with Ezekiel 35:12, identifies the race that would live in the land. It doesn't say Japheth. There is no biblical text that says Japheth lives in the land. The Bible says Idumea would take and live in the land.

“with the joy of all their heart”: they were happy to steal, to spoil the land. “with despiteful minds”: they took the land despite knowing the land doesn't belong to them, despite the fact they're not the Jews.

“to cast it out for a prey”: they called their fellow Idumeans from Poland, Russia, Germany, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan and Ukraine and said, come, take a part, and a lot of them came. That is why, if you listen to them speak, they speak German, Polish and Russian with those accents. They are not the people of the land.

That is the vision the robbers of thy people exalt themselves to establish in Daniel 11:14, and God has spoken against all Idumea in the fire of his jealousy. They shall fall.

precepts.label: 1 Kings 8:47
precepts.why:
Hosea says the children of Israel shall be “as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered”: dispersed, so that we could be preserved. And “in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living God.” We are hearing that now and seeing it now. Our teachers tell us these things, we identify with them, and that is how we regain our identity.

Solomon’s prayer shows the steps: “Yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives, and repent, and make supplication unto thee in the land of them that carried them captives, saying, We have sinned, and have done perversely, we have committed wickedness”.

First we have to bethink ourselves: remember ourselves and reclaim our identity, right here in the land of our captivity. That is part of the strangeness of our salvation. Then we repent and make supplication, and then God will acknowledge us, be for us and fight for us.

This is not a time of peace but a time of war. Not physical war: there is nothing we can do against these powers and nations physically. What we can do is unite as a people, come back together, keep God’s laws in solidarity, and wait on our Redeemer. In the place where we were called not his people, we remember who we are, we repent, and we are called the sons of the living God.

precepts.label: 1 Corinthians 1:21
precepts.why:
How do we bring about that change? How do you fight a nuke? How do you fight powers that can turn off your lights, run your economy and take your resources right under your nose while you say thank you? With something small and simple: “For after that in the wisdom of God the world by wisdom knew not God, it pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe.”

It was God’s wisdom that the world would not know him, that they would purposely not be able to understand. It is given unto us to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God; he made everything a mystery so that only his elect can unseal what the Bible says. And just as it pleases him to see a man lifted up in power so that he can take him down, it pleases him to save by the foolishness of preaching. That is how we get our identity back. That is how we come back.

So look at the brothers in the streets. Don’t think those efforts are small; they are making an impact. Even if your camp doesn’t have a lot of foot traffic, none of it is in vain, none of it is void. You go out, you preach, you gather, you fish. Even if there are scarce fish in that water, if you know there is a spot where fish be, you stay there until you catch at least one. You are not trying to come home empty.

It starts with preaching and then it escalates. First we repent, then we get the honor. We do not fight physically now: we repent now, we fight through preaching, and God fights for us later. Then comes the honor of Psalm 149, “a twoedged sword in their hand; To execute vengeance upon the heathen”, for “this honour have all his saints.” When he shall roar, “the children shall tremble from the west”, the western hemisphere, “and I will place them in their houses, saith the Lord”: our tribes, our royal heritage and our identity given back to us, the sons of the living God.

precepts.label: 1 Esdras 8:69
precepts.why:
“Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people”, sometimes willingly, sometimes not. You have knuckleheads who say that is only talking about their customs. It was biological and it was symbolic, dummy. The Bible defines the Bible, and Ezra shows what mixing means: “The nation of Israel, the princes, the priests and Levites, have not put away from them the strange people of the land, nor the pollutions of the Gentiles.”

We did not put away the strange people from the land. We sought after them, because of the ideology of whitening, of bettering the race. The pollutions of the Gentiles are their idolatry and their doctrines, and we became corrupt in our merchandise and commerce. All Israel had that propensity, but here the focus is the northern kingdom.

Read on: “For both they and their sons have married with their daughters, and the holy seed is mixed with the strange people of the land.” When it says mixed himself among the people, it means the seed gets mixed. What is the seed? Sperm, semen. So when somebody comes to you with that BS, this is the scripture to put there: mixing means mixing.

It goes on: “and from the beginning of this matter the rulers and the great men have been partakers of this iniquity.” All of us partook of that, and it is a sin to mix with the other nations. That is why Ephraim is a cake not turned: light on one side and dark on the other, all the different shades among the northern kingdom, and some of our own people with blonde hair and blue eyes whose father is Israel.

precepts.label: Psalms 106:35
precepts.why:
“Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people.” Ezra already showed that the holy seed was mixed with the strange people of the land. David gives the other side of it: “But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.” It was not just ideological, dummies, and some of the ones saying it went to seminary school and call themselves theologians. When you look up the definition of mingled, it goes into mixing, just like First Esdras. And they learned their works too.

So Hosea is talking about ideology, and it is also talking about the seed, like we just proved. Scholars know the whitening was both ideological and biological. “Ephraim is a cake not turned. Strangers have devoured his strength.” The cake not turned is the colours, light and dark: some of us light, some in between, some dark.

The strangers devoured more than the strength of the royal seed. Our strength lies in the Lord, the joy of the Lord is our strength, and the ideology cut us away from him. We cannot fight the United States; our countries cannot do any of that. It is time we come back to God. Strangers devoured his strength, “and he knoweth it not: yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, yet he knoweth not.” Many of our older people are not hearing it; the gray hairs are upon them and they cannot accept it.

And this goes with Matthew 13 and Amos 9, especially for you northern kingdom brothers. Southern kingdom, learn northern kingdom history with the same vigour and zeal that we learn yours. If you are a fisher of men, you fish all the different kinds of fish that pertain to Israel and Christ.

precepts.label: Jeremiah 12:9
precepts.why:
Ephraim mixed himself among the people and became “a cake not turned”, light and dark. Jeremiah shows how the Lord sees that mixed people: “Mine heritage is unto me as a speckled bird, the birds round about are against her; come ye, assemble all the beasts of the field, come to devour.”

We are a speckled bird, and the birds round about against her are the enemy. They know who we are because of the caste system. Though we are mixed, they know who we are. In Panama they call the light-skinned ones one name and the darker ones, some of whom are Benjamin, another, and the lady at the hotel sized each of us up by our shade the same way.

But the Lord had a way to fix that, because the Israelite seed is that strong: go back to the Israelite line, and it does not matter how mixed the daughter was. And Hosea says Ephraim would “bring forth his children to the murderer”: Cain, Esau, Edom, the Spaniards, the United States. For those who willingly tried to whiten the race: “give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.” Many of those babies died.

So the speckled bird is still his heritage. “How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? how shall I deliver thee, Israel?” Though he struck us with these curses, he will not make us as Admah and Zeboim, the cities round about Sodom and Gomorrah that were utterly destroyed. Our job is to give the word, go to the chief places where our people resort, and let God do the separating.

thread.label: Hosea 9:13
thread.text: Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus, is planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.

classes.title: Raising Cain: The Son of Perdition, Merchants, and Captive Nations

precepts.label: Deuteronomy 28:45
precepts.why:
Ephraim was “planted in a pleasant place”, the blessings, but “Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.” The murderer is Cain, Esau, Edom: the Spaniards, the United States. That was the whitening, el blanqueamiento, sometimes done willingly and sometimes not. So God said “give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.” Many of the babies of those who tried to whiten us out died, and what is left behind is largely not European; many who look European there came over later. Our job is to give the word, go to the chief places where our people resort as Christ taught, and let God do the separating.

How could a people fall so low, go through so much, and still rise and reconnect to their identity? People are baffled by it; to them it is ignorant and even offensive for us to know who we are. Deuteronomy 28:45 answers it: “Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the Lord thy God.” And “they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.”

Those curses became our identity, and our redemption. They are the way we acknowledge who we are and make our way back. If not these curses, then who is it? The Bible always said Israel would come back to its identity, and now that we are back, the world is bugging out. Where are the lost tribes? They are here now.

It is God's grand plan. If we were all together in one spot, they could have wiped us out. By dispersing us into the four corners of the earth he also preserved us, like the worm in the movie Swordfish, broken up and scattered to the four corners of the internet so no one could get it back without the one who hid it. What was our curse, God meant for good, so that now we can come back together. As Hosea said, the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, and “in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living God.”

thread.text: How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? how shall I deliver thee, Israel? how shall I make thee as Admah? how shall I set thee as Zeboim? mine heart is turned within me, my repentings are kindled together.

precepts.label: Zechariah 9:13
precepts.why:
“How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? how shall I deliver thee, Israel?” God is saying, how am I going to turn away from you, my son, and deliver you forever to the heathen? Admah and Zeboim were the cities round about Sodom and Gomorrah that were utterly destroyed, and he cannot do that to us. Though he strikes us with righteous judgment in these curses, he has not forgotten us. “I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger”: all the horror of these curses we deal with is mercy.

What comes after the repentance is the honor, and Zechariah shows it: “Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope”, that is, repent, and “even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee”. Then: “When I have bent Judah for me, filled the bow with Ephraim, and raised up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece, and made thee as the sword of a mighty man.”

This is talking about a weapon. Judah is bent first, like the bow, and then he fills the bow with Ephraim, like an arrow. It is the same order as Hosea 11:10: he roars like a lion because the tents of Judah are raised first, and the northern kingdom sees that example and follows it, and the children tremble from the west, from the western hemisphere. Thy sons, O Greece, goes into Edom, Esau, Cain, all these countries that rule with a fist of iron.

“And the Lord shall be seen over them, and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning”. That arrow is us. Christ leads the charge, and we get to move like that too, with the two-edged sword in our hand to execute vengeance upon the heathen, the honor all his saints have. “they shall drink, and make a noise as through wine; and they shall be filled like bowls, and as the corners of the altar”: we partake in the vengeance, like the blood of the sacrifice filling the bowls thrown on the altar. We don't just stand by and watch it.

So we don't fight physically now; we repent now and fight through preaching, and God fights for us later. He will place us in our houses, tell us, you're from Asher, you're from Ephraim, from Simeon, Issachar, Zebulun, Naphtali, and give us back our royal heritage and our identity.

precepts.label: Psalms 140:11
precepts.why:
“The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee, thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?” There is a set time for the times of the Gentiles to be fulfilled, with Esau at the top, that same spirit of Cain in rulership. But it is temporary. Waiting generation after generation for his judgment, the pride of his heart has deceived him. He forgot what his judgment is and thinks he is untouchable, especially after seeing what his weapons did to the air defences of Russia and China.

Now Trump is talking like that. On Air Force One after capturing Maduro he names the countries he will come after: Colombia, run by a sick man; Mexico, where the cartels are running things. He says the vice president of Venezuela will face a situation probably worse than Maduro, and emphasises how fast and violent it was: it was very violent. That office once had prestige, and though they did their evil, they at least spoke well. He is not even bothering with appearances anymore.

David shows where that ends: “Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.” You reap what you sow. What he puts out is the exact same way his demise is going to come.

That is the lineage of Cain: Tubal-cain was “an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron”, and where others saw tools his mind saw weapons. Murder led to industry, hatred to technology, and violence to institutional power. Esau was told, “by thy sword shalt thou live.” But who shall bring him down to the ground? It is prophesied: first all those he dealt with will turn against him, and then Christ and his elect will have the glory and the honour to take him down.

precepts.label: Zechariah 9:13
precepts.why:
Habakkuk sees Christ coming: “Thy bow was made quite naked, according to the oaths of the tribes, even thy word.” The oaths of the tribes is the Bible. A bow in hand means you are coming for war, so according to the oaths of Jacob, Christ is coming for war. Zechariah shows what that bow is: “When I have bent Judah for me, filled the bow with Ephraim, and raised up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece”.

The Lord bends Judah for himself like a bow and fills the bow with Ephraim: Judah and Ephraim are the bow and the arrow. He raises up the sons of Zion, the rest of the twelve tribes, against the sons of Greece: against the Greeks, the white man. That is war.

That is why this tribulation will not be like any other we have gone through. There will be wars like we have never seen, and in the midst of world war Christ comes: Armageddon. “Thou didst march through the land in indignation, thou didst thresh the heathen in anger.” Indignation is righteous anger, and he beats the nations in it. The arrows and the glittering spear are the missiles being shot.

And the war is for his people alone: “Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people, even for salvation with thine anointed”. He is only coming to save the twelve tribes of Israel. “Thou woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked”: that is the white man, and America is the head, discovered “unto the neck” to make sure it is finished. Judah and Ephraim in his hand are how he does it.

precepts.label: Malachi 4:1
precepts.why:
The Lord said, “I have created the waster to destroy.” What weapon at that time could have been called the waster? Nothing. Zechariah describes it: “Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet, and their eyes shall consume away in their holes, and their tongue shall consume away in their mouth.” Could anybody then fathom a weapon that did those things? Malachi shows the day it is fulfilled: “For, behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven”.

The prophets did not know about nuclear weapons and atoms back then. They got these visions and explained them the best they could, and the best way to say it was: the waster. God put it on man to make that instrument, and there will be a day when that plague is fulfilled.

“And all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble”: not just Esau and the other nations, but even rebellious Israel, the ones that do not repent. “And the day that cometh shall burn them up, saith the Lord of hosts, that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.” When you burn something it leaves ashes, but with this waster nothing remains. They show dramatic images, but the body does not survive that heat; whatever ash there is is blown into the atmosphere. You are totally gone.

And here is the beauty of it: God put it in their spirit to make that thing, and he is going to use that same thing to end them. The weapon they feel gave them their power, authority and respect, he will turn against them.

precepts.label: 2 Peter 3:9
precepts.why:
Zechariah's plague and Malachi's day that burns as an oven are coming, so why has it not come yet? Peter answers: “The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.”

The only reason it tarries is that the Lord is waiting for us. It is not really a set time the way we see it: the time is when that set number is sealed, and God knows when that will be. That is why there is no date for it that we are aware of.

“But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night”: when you least suspect it, that is when it comes. “In the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat”. In those days they could not imagine what that sounded like; it sounded terrifying. Now that we understand it, it is no less terrifying, because we know what those nukes can do.

The Lord stays their hand enough that they do not want to use them. They sign treaties against nuclear proliferation because they know if one fires, the other fires back, and it's a wrap, a zero-sum game, the end of the world as they know it. It is like the game Civilization: it lets you build and use a nuke, but once you use it the game ends, because you destroyed the whole earth. The Lord holds it back while he waits for his people to come to repentance.

precepts.label: 2 Peter 3:12
precepts.why:
Peter says, “Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness, Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?” The heavens will be on fire: what else could he be talking about? It is the waster of Zechariah, flesh consuming away while they stand upon their feet.

We hear all this and say, okay, great, but it should move us. What manner of persons ought we to be? In all holiness and godliness. Paul says the same: “Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober.” Sober means don't drink of the mark of the beast, don't drink her wine, don't be so asleep that you think you're an American and nothing is going to touch you. God has not appointed us to wrath; he does not want his elect to be part of that death and destruction.

Looking for and hasting unto that day means you should be able to look boldly and say, I'm looking for it and I want it to come quickly. It is not the time to be divided in BS and simple issues, but to come together stronger and more united, growing in faith and understanding and applying it.

Don't worry that this place is going to be burned away: “Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.” That fire is a baptism by fire that cleanses all the evil and reforms the earth so it is fit for our new forms and for the new kingdom. Thy will be done in earth as it is in heaven: the kingdom is coming down, and this place has to be transformed.

precepts.label: Job 9:24
precepts.why:
“The burden of the word of the Lord to Israel by Malachi.” “I loved Jacob, And I hated Esau, and laid his mountains and his heritage waste”. That is what Paul refers to in Romans 9 when he says, as it is written. Esau went through some things at different times: they became the cavemen, came out of the caves and started taking people's identity, the fugitives and vagabonds that they were. But his ultimate, permanent judgment was deferred for a set time. “Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places”, and during the Renaissance they did. “They shall build, but I will throw down; and they shall call them, The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.”

Job shows why he has the power for now: “The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, and who is he?” The border of wickedness is the mark; people will know. And the indignation for ever tells you judgment was reserved for him, but God needed to use him for a time for his plan.

If not, who is he? If it is not Esau, if it is not the United States of America, who is it? The prophets saw visions of rooms like this: the president seated up high with the vice president and the speaker beside him, and the United Nations the same on a bigger scale, all the nations with their hierarchies on one accord. That is why the scriptures say they were confederate.

It is like Cain: he was supposed to be judged, pleaded, and the Lord put a mark on him and deferred it. Revenge is a dish best served cold. How much better to let this man get so high in power and authority that he thinks he can stop God, and then take him down.

precepts.label: Luke 21:24
precepts.why:
Esau's judgment was deferred for a time, and Christ gave the time: “And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.”

There is a set time that has to be fulfilled for these heathen nations, starting with Esau at the top: the same spirit of Cain in rulership. But it is temporary.

Through the process of time, waiting generation after generation for his judgment, Esau has forgotten it, or at least his pomp and pride make him think he is untouchable. Obadiah says, “The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee”, “that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?” And who blames him? Look at what they just did to the air defenses Russia and China supplied. Trump now talks like that, of taking Venezuela and coming after Colombia and Mexico, and boasts that it was so fast and violent.

But it is prophesied who will bring him down. All those he dealt with will turn against him, and then Christ and his elect will have the glory and the honor to take him down. “evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.” When the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled, his time is up.

precepts.label: Amos 9:9
precepts.why:
In the parable, “while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat”. A mixing happened: bad seed sown in among the good seed. “An enemy hath done this.” It was done on purpose. For the Northern Kingdom tribes in this hemisphere, that was the whitening the Spaniards practiced: marrying to lighter skin to better the race, with a whole caste system of names for every kind of mixing. They found the tribes, and since they could not kill us all outright, they tried to pollute the royal seed. But however watered down the daughter is, one man with the seed of an Israelite brings it back.

The servants asked, should we gather up the tares? “Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them. Let both grow together until the harvest”. It is not for us to determine, because of the way this went down; we do not know who is and who is not. At the harvest the angels will know who is Israel.

Amos proves it: “For, lo, I will command, and I will sift the house of Israel among all nations”. Why among all nations? Because through the whitening, the mixing and the captivities, God himself has to be the one to sift us. “Like as corn is sifted in a sieve, yet shall not the least grain fall upon the earth.” It will be determined who is who. Even Adam had to walk through a gate; you do not have twelve gates with twelve names and think somebody is going to sneak through. God said he will do it. My sheep hear my voice, and you know them by their works.

“All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword, which say, The evil shall not overtake nor prevent us.” He is going to kill a lot of them, before, during and even some after. So we narrow down where our people gather and go to the chief places of concourse, not to where the Edomites are, and give the word; and let God do the separating.

precepts.label: Revelation 13:6
precepts.why:
Christ warned, “For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.” John says the same beast “opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, and them that dwell in heaven.”

To come in Christ's name saying I am Christ, I am Christian, I am the people of Christ, is blaspheming his name, because they are not the Christ of the Bible. That is Christianity. In the 1400s, during the Renaissance, they changed over the black icons all over Europe and set themselves up as the anointed ones, the people of God, the Jew. They came in the name of Christ and set up that false religion and deceived the whole world.

You heard it from their own mouths. Jake Lang, the one burning Qurans and causing riots this week, said Jesus was a white Jewish man just like him, and that God would not make himself not white. That is blasphemy against God. They call themselves Christians: that is blasphemy against his name. They call themselves the white angels: that is blasphemy, a lie told against the Bible. Christianity and Judaism cannot be separated; to set up Christianity they had to set themselves and their race up as the Jews and erase the history of the real Jews.

Do they love Jesus? They love him once he looks like them. Tell them Jesus Christ is a black man and you see the anger in their face. They hate black people and they hate Christ. That whole religious system is the antichrist system, against the true Christ, and the world calls us a hate group and black extremists for saying we are the Jews and the believers of Christ.

precepts.label: Acts 13:1
precepts.why:
Christ said many would come in his name and deceive many by changing who he and his people are. So look at what the apostles and prophets were called: “Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene.”

They were called what? Niger means black. The white man uses that term as a derogatory word, but the prophets were called black right through history. So if the prophets were black, what does that mean Christ was? Black too.

And the same way they were called that then, we are called that today. Nothing has changed. The people of the Bible were black, which is why the false Christ of Christianity, the white Jesus, is a deception. Christianity is built on white supremacy, on murder and bloodshed, and those who come in Christ's name with a white image are against the Christ of the Bible.

precepts.label: Revelation 7:1-4
precepts.why:
“And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.” Some say that contradicts Isaiah 66, where the Lord gathers his people out of the nations. It does not. The world Christ speaks of here goes into the 144,000, and Revelation 7 shows it.

“I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.” The four winds are destruction. The earth is the armies on land; the sea is the navy and the marines; any tree is the air force, which comes down above the trees.

“And I saw another angel ascending from the east, having the seal of the living God”. The seal of the living God is the law: “Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.” That is what the angel is looking for.

Verse three is the point that ties in with Matthew 24: “Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.” Do not let the destruction come until the servants of God are sealed. “And there were sealed an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.”

Once the 144,000 are sealed, then shall the end come: destruction upon destruction upon destruction. And because the 144,000 are scattered among the nations, the gospel must be preached among all the nations. That is why we must go out and prophesy and teach among all these different nations: our people are there.

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 13:5
precepts.why:
Revelation 7 shows four angels holding back the four winds of the earth. What is the wind? Ezra gives the precept: “And after this I beheld, and, lo, there was gathered together a multitude of men, out of number, from the four winds of the heaven, to subdue the man that came out of the sea”.

A multitude of men out of number, coming from the four winds of heaven. The winds are the armies of the nations gathering, and the destruction they bring. They come “to subdue the man that came out of the sea”: to subdue Christ. They want to fight Christ, the Son of God.

That goes back to Daniel 8:25, where they stand up against the Prince of princes, but he is broken without hand. It is saying the same thing.

So when the angels hold the four winds so that they blow not on the earth, the sea or any tree, they are holding back the armies of the nations, on land, on sea and in the air, until the servants of God are sealed. Then the winds are let loose, the nations gather to fight Christ at his coming, and the end comes.

precepts.label: Isaiah 8:16
precepts.why:
In Revelation 7 another angel ascends from the east “having the seal of the living God”, and he cries to the four angels, “Hurt not the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, till we have sealed the servants of our God in their foreheads.” What is the seal of the living God?

Isaiah answers: “Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.” The seal is the law, the commandments. That is what the angel is looking for, and that is what he is doing: sealing the law among the disciples, the servants of God, in their foreheads, meaning in their minds.

The ones sealed are “an hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel.” When they are sealed with the law, the destruction is let loose and the end comes.

So the gospel of the kingdom preached in all the world for a witness is the law and the testimony going out to our people scattered among the nations, sealing them before the end. He that endures to the end, keeping it, the same shall be saved.

precepts.label: Isaiah 45:4
precepts.why:
Christ says that after the tribulation of those days, when the stars fall from heaven (the missiles the prophets saw) and the powers of the heavens are shaken, “he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.” Who is the elect?

Isaiah answers: “For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel mine elect”. Israel is the elect. The elect gathered from the four winds are the twelve tribes of Israel, scattered to the ends of the earth.

And notice when it happens. He comes in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory after the tribulation and the war. There is no thought that he might come tomorrow; the tribulation has not come yet, and World War III is already in process. First the war and the shaking of Idumea, the powers of the heavens; then the sign of the Son of man, all the tribes of the earth mourning, and the gathering of Jacob's seed, Israel his elect, out of every nation where they were scattered.

precepts.label: Ezekiel 28:25
precepts.why:
Christ said the angels “shall gather together his elect from the four winds”. Ezekiel shows who does the gathering and from where: “Thus saith the Lord God; When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered”.

When who? The Lord God. The house of Israel is gathered from among the people where they are scattered: from the nations, from the four winds. So what is Netanyahu talking about? What are the not-so-Israelis over there talking about? The gathering is God's, and it is out of the nations, not a state set up by men.

“And shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen, then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob.” Only when God has gathered them do they dwell in the land he gave to Jacob.

That is also the answer when someone on the street brings up Revelation 7:9 and the great multitude out of all nations: it is the house of Israel, gathered from among the people where they were scattered, the elect of Isaiah 45, “Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel mine elect”.

precepts.label: 2 Peter 2:5
precepts.why:
Christ said “as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be.” Noe is the Greek; it is still Noah. In his days they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, “until the day that Noe entered into the ark.” So what was Noah doing all that time? Peter tells us.

God “spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly.” Noah was a preacher of righteousness: a preacher of God's laws, because that is what righteous means, his laws. He was warning the people to repent and change their ways, and the people mocked him and laughed at him.

Then they “knew not until the flood came, and took them all away.” Took them away into what? Not the kingdom of heaven: destruction, death. Took is the past tense of take. So when Christ says “the one shall be taken, and the other left”, the one taken is taken to destruction, like the ungodly in the flood, and the one left is the righteous, like Noah.

So it shall be at Christ's coming: nations eating and drinking and carrying on, while those preaching God's laws are mocked, until the destruction comes on the world of the ungodly. “Therefore be ye also ready.”

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 16:74-76
precepts.why:
Christ said “Watch therefore” and “Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.” Brothers and sisters, we have to be ready. Ezra gives the Lord's word to those who are: “Hear, O ye my beloved, saith the Lord: behold, the days of trouble are at hand, but I will deliver you from the same.”

The days of trouble are at hand, but the Lord will deliver his beloved from them. “Be ye not afraid neither doubt; for God is your guide, And the guide of them who keep my commandments and precepts, saith the Lord God: let not your sins weigh you down, and let not your iniquities lift up themselves.” God is the guide of those who keep his commandments and precepts; they are the ones left when the others are taken to destruction.

This is the same thing Noah was preaching back then, but nobody listened; everybody mocked him. The message is the same now: keep the commandments, don't let your sins weigh you down, and be ready, because the day comes in an hour you think not.

precepts.label: Lamentations 1:1
precepts.why:
In the parable “there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary.” We are that widow. The Lord said he was married unto us, but because we sinned, he refused us. Jeremiah shows the same widow: “How doth the city sit solitary, that was full of people! how is she become as a widow!”

“she that was great among the nations, and princess among the provinces, how is she become tributary”! That is Israel: once full of people, great among the nations, a princess among the provinces, now alone, cast off like a widow, and paying tribute to others. Christ is making reference back to that in Luke 18.

So the widow crying “Avenge me of mine adversary” is us, the twelve tribes, crying for vengeance on our enemies. We want revenge. “he would not for a while”, just as the Lord kept silence for a time, but “because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.” Because the twelve tribes trouble him, he will avenge her. That is the key: pray for vengeance and don't stop.

“And shall not God avenge his own elect, which cry day and night unto him”? We are the elect, crying day and night, three times a day. Some of our people call it unjust that God put us in slavery and punished us, and ask why an all-loving God would do that. It is not unjust: you punish your kids when they go off, and likewise the Lord. “I tell you that he will avenge them speedily.” The question Christ asks is whether, when he comes, he will find that faith: will the widow still be praying for vengeance?

precepts.label: Micah 4:10
precepts.why:
Paul and Barnabas went about “Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.” The tribulation hasn't fully started; you see it on a certain scale, but it will intensify. It will get worse, and worse, and worse.

Micah says how to go through it: “Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail”. The Bible says to be in pain. Pain is coming, and it has already begun; pay attention to what Trump and these people are doing. But whatever pain you go through, you still have to labour, labouring in this truth.

“for now shalt thou go forth out of the city, and thou shalt dwell in the field, and thou shalt go even to Babylon”. Where are we living today? Babylon: Mystery Babylon the Great, the United States of America.

Why does it say like a woman in travail? Because the pain comes and it goes, and when the baby is close to coming the pains increase and get worse and worse. That is what you see taking place now. Whether this society has another ten or twenty years, as the time draws nearer the pains will increase: the affliction rising against those of us that fear God. Keep labouring through them.

That is why the brother who is not studying and applying the scriptures has no root and will not survive it; when things get real he will be offended, scared, and go back into the world. Sisters, a brother who never teaches and is never in a camp video is a gamble.

precepts.label: Revelation 12:17
precepts.why:
Much tribulation is coming, and Revelation shows where it comes from: “And the dragon was wroth with the woman”. The dragon is the beast, the white man, Esau. According to the prophecy they will be angry at us, “and went to make war with the remnant of her seed”.

Why? Not because we are evil or terrorists, but because we “keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.” The testimony of Jesus Christ is everything written in this book, everything the prophets said would happen, everything written about who the wicked are and all the evil the so-called white man is doing. That testimony says these people are the synagogue of Satan, and that God is bringing judgment on them for all their evil on the earth. As you teach it, they get angry and make war with us.

So do not think we will be out there teaching the Bible and everything will be good. The tribulation will be attacks from the government: labelling us a hate group, lying on us, putting us in prison, hitting your pocket and your food, attacking your wife and your children, because those are the things we care about. In the end they will force idol worship: worship the beast, or you can't buy, sell, work, get a job or go to the doctor.

The dragon is wroth, and he will make war with us. That is the much tribulation through which we must enter into the kingdom of God, and why we must be exhorted to continue in the faith.

precepts.label: Amos 3:1-2
precepts.why:
“And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.” What is good about all the evil we have been watching? All of it is good, because the Lord has been warning our people, the twelve tribes, in the Bible for centuries, and we have not listened, not repented, not returned to him; we have gone into strange religions and worshipped a strange God we think is Jesus Christ. All things includes the things we think are bad for us. There is a divine purpose behind it. We are the called according to his purpose.

“For whom he did foreknow”. Foreknow means knew from the past. Go back to the Old Testament: who did he foreknow? Amos answers: “Hear this word that the Lord hath spoken against you, O children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up from the land of Egypt, saying, You only have I known of all the families of the earth”. For whom he did foreknow: you only have I known. The twelve tribes of Israel.

“therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities”. Because he knew us, he punished us, and the punishment itself is part of the all things that work together for good. It is his warning to return.

“he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son”. Predestinated who? The twelve tribes of Israel, whom he is transforming into the image of Christ, his Son, “that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.”

precepts.label: Isaiah 45:25
precepts.why:
“Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified”. Here is that word again, predestinate. And who is justified? Isaiah: “In the Lord shall all the seed of Israel be justified, and shall glory.”

We are the ones being justified, not all nations on the planet. Paul is not saying everybody on the planet is going to be justified. He did not make things up and pull them out of the sky; he is getting that from what Isaiah wrote.

“and whom he justified, them he also glorified”. The seed of Israel justified in the Lord “shall glory”, and he shall be glorified in his Son.

That is why Paul goes on: “If God be for us, who can be against us?” Who can conquer us, who can destroy us? Nobody on this planet, no matter what comes our way. The seed of Israel, called and justified in the Lord, are more than conquerors through him that loved us, and nothing shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

precepts.label: 2 Thessalonians 2:9-12
precepts.why:
“But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost”. If you do not understand that Christ is a black man, that the children of the transatlantic slave trade are the Jews according to the Bible, and that Christ is coming to bring vengeance on all nations that oppress us, it is because you are lost. “In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not”. Some say the god of this world is the spiritual demon Satan, but always start with his physical counterpart: the so-called white man, who creates these technologies and deceives the world physically. He blinds your mind with his mouth, that great mouth speaking lies and blasphemy.

Thessalonians shows how: “Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan”. That is America, coming into power after the working of the spiritual demon Satan, “with all power and signs and lying wonders”: the technology, the media, social media. “And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish; because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved.” You did not love this truth. You loved the white man and his lies, and you hate yourself.

“And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie”. A delusion is a false belief or judgment about external reality, held despite incontrovertible evidence to the contrary. We show our people the evidence and it does not matter. The lies are that the white man is the Jew, when Christ called them the synagogue of Satan; that white people are the Christians, when the Christians were the Israelites that converted and followed Christ; that you can eat pork and shrimp; that Christ came and died for all nations. Christianity is under that delusion, and so are those who believe the people in the land of Israel are the Jews. They cannot come out unless God opens their eyes.

So God allows America to do crazy stuff on this earth, and uses it to wake his people up and break the spell of that strong delusion. “That they all might be damned who believed not the truth”: everyone that does not believe this truth will be damned, with no repentance. You can curse us and call us names; it is what it is.

precepts.label: Matthew 24:24
precepts.why:
“For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets”. That is Christianity, what you see here today: the image of the beast, the white man coming and speaking lies in Christ's name. That is the god of this world blinding the minds of them which believe not.

“and shall shew great signs and wonders”: his technology. That is his mouth, the television, the Hollywood movies. Growing up we watched Captain America and GI Joe, the American heroes, and now the Avengers. All of it puts white people forward as what they are not. Those things were brainwashing us and messing with our minds.

“insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.” Is it possible for them to deceive the elect? No. The illusion and delusion is so strong that if it were possible, even the elect would have been taken. But it is not possible. That is why we are waking up today and see clearly. They cannot trick us or fool us; we are not under that delusion, though the whole world is.

This is the mouth of the dragon: social media and technology, used to monitor, control and deceive the people and put propaganda out there. Netanyahu and the Israeli government want to control social media to stop the truth from going forth, as they took down our pages before, and soon we will not be teaching on YouTube at all. But the elect cannot be deceived by that mouth, and God will make their own tongue fall upon themselves.

Our fathers in the wilderness “did all eat the same spiritual meat”, “And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Christ.” What sustained Israel was spiritual, and it was Christ. “But with many of them God was not well pleased”.

That is why Paul says “For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh”. We walk in the physical, but we do not war after the physical. This is spiritual warfare. “For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds”. Our job is “Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God”, casting down every evil imagination in the mind of our people, “and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ”, the black Messiah.

So get your mind right and get your mind together, so you can prepare for the second coming of Christ. No matter what happens in this place, do not get caught up in foolishness. If they can treat a white woman like that in Minnesota, imagine how they can treat us. Do not go out there talking about helping march. This is not your problem. Stay in the scripture.

Even your own family in the world, who tell you they hate the Most High, will call and pull you into their stupidity: that's my brother, that's my mama. Do not get caught up. Our job is to get our people ready for the second coming.

precepts.label: Galatians 2:4
precepts.why:
“I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel: Which is not another”. It is not another because it is found in the law of Moses. “but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.” They are the same men of Acts 15, who went out from us and troubled the churches. Paul says, if any man preach any other gospel, “let him be accursed”. Those men were running around joining the churches and causing confusion by infiltration, pushing a gospel we are no longer under: going back to sacrificing animals. That is another gospel.

Chapter 2 names them: “And that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage”. The liberty we have is that we no longer offer up animals. Christ died on the cross, and we are free from that burden. The bondage they wanted to bring us into was sacrificing animals again to be saved, like Acts 15.

So Galatians 5 says “Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.” If animal sacrifice saves you, Christ died for nothing and you are fallen from grace. Yet “ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh”: do not use this freedom to do what you want and sin.

Likewise today, Christians will come in here and do the same thing: accept the identity, but not the theology, using the same book and the same Bible to push Christianity. That is the same infiltration in reverse. As John says, “They went out from us, but they were not of us”, and those who trouble you shall bear their judgment.

precepts.label: Romans 13:14
precepts.why:
“Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.” What does it mean to walk in the Spirit? It does not mean moonwalking or walking on the air. Romans explains it: “But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ”, that is, the commandments and your faith, “and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.” To make provision for the flesh is not walking in the Spirit.

To make provision is to make a way for you to fulfil that lust, leaving doors open for the sin. Why are you on the phone with your ex? You are going to end up banging her. If you are struggling, delete Instagram and delete certain things; put controls on your phone so you cannot go on certain things. People say, I made a mistake, I slipped and fell, I don't know what happened. So you were walking and just slipped and fell on the dude? There was planning. You were talking to him first, and you planned what day to meet up. It was already in your mind. It was a decision, not a mistake.

With porn, if it is that bad, get rid of social media. Do not say, I can handle it, I'm good. That is Satan telling you that, and leaving it open keeps fuelling the lust, because every time you go on you see a bunch of different stuff. Some of you say you repented but leave little doors open, and you fall back into that sin. Sit down and talk to yourself: I am dealing with this, so I need to set things up so I do not fall into it.

Because “the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh”. It is a war: you want to stop, you stop for a week or two, and it comes back. The works of the flesh are “Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness”, all sexual sins. That discipline applies in marriage too: forty or eighty days after your wife gives birth, and her seven days. Satan does not come when you are dealing with your woman; he comes when you are not getting any. Those are the days to fast more and occupy yourself with the Lord. As men we cannot let pleasure control us.

precepts.label: Psalms 148:14
precepts.why:
Paul calls it “the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints.” The whole question is who those saints are, and the Psalm answers it: “He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel.” The saints are the children of Israel.

A lot of times, when you pull up these key words, it shuts Christians down. They read “saints” and picture everybody who ever went to church. But the scripture defines its own words. The saints are his people, the children of Israel, and the mystery Paul was made a minister of was made manifest to them.

So when Colossians 1:26 says the mystery is now made manifest “to his saints”, it is saying it is made manifest to Israel. That is who Paul was writing to, and that is who the mystery belongs to.

precepts.label: Psalms 50:4-5
precepts.why:
This follows up on the saints: “Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.” Read the verse above it and see who is sent to do the gathering: “He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.”

The heavens from above are the angels. The earth is the prophets. And what is the message to the angels and to the prophets? “Gather my saints together unto me.” So when the angels come, they are only gathering the saints. They are not gathering all races on the planet. They are only gathering the saints, the ones he judges as “his people.”

The angels and the prophets are only looking for Israelites, those that made a covenant with God by sacrifice. That is not all races on the planet. That is not the Philistines. That is not the Ishmaelites. That is not the Moabites. Only Israel.

So the saints that the mystery of Colossians 1:26 is made manifest to are the same saints the angels come to gather: the children of Israel, the people of the covenant.

precepts.label: Matthew 4:15
precepts.why:
Colossians 1:27 goes on: “To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles.” Now you get to that word Gentiles and they go, ooh, we got you there. No, you ain’t got nobody. Matthew explains the Gentiles.

“The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles.” Zabulon and Nephthalim are tribes of Israel, and their land is what they called “Galilee of the Gentiles.” Israelites living scattered among the nations were called Gentiles.

So the Gentiles that the mystery is regarding are not all races. When Paul speaks of the riches of the glory of this mystery “among the Gentiles”, he is speaking of Israelites that were called Gentiles, the same people the mystery was made manifest to as saints.

precepts.label: Isaiah 11:10-13
precepts.why:
Here is a follow-up, in case Matthew is not good enough for you. “And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign of the people; to it shall the Gentiles seek: and his rest shall be glorious.” That root of Jesse is Christ. To it shall the Gentiles seek. So the subject is Gentiles, and we want to see who these Gentiles are.

“the Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people.” So these Gentiles are the remnant of the Lord’s people, recovered “from Assyria”, that is modern day Turkey; “and from Egypt, and from Pathros”, that is Sudan; “and from Cush”, Ethiopia; “and from Elam”, Persia; “and from Shinar”, Iraq; “and from Hamath”, Syria; “and from the islands of the sea.”

Then it gets more specific: “he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.” These Gentiles are the outcasts of Israel and the dispersed of Judah.

Now, you might be saying, but blacks and Latinos don’t get along too much. Read the next verse: “The envy also of Ephraim shall depart, and the adversaries of Judah shall be cut off: Ephraim shall not envy Judah, and Judah shall not vex Ephraim.” That is dealing with the hatred between our people. If they want salvation, it does not matter how much they don’t like each other in California. God don’t give a damn.

So the “mystery among the Gentiles” in Colossians 1:27 is Christ, the root of Jesse, gathering the outcasts of Israel and the dispersed of Judah back together, and ending the envy between them.

precepts.label: Leviticus 19:17-18
precepts.why:
Isaiah said Ephraim shall not envy Judah, and Judah shall not vex Ephraim. Here is what that is talking about: “Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him. Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the Lord.”

Love your neighbour as you love yourself, and your neighbour is the children of your people. That word people, children of your people, is the children of your race. You ain’t never been taught that in church. The children of your people is not the Chinese. The children of your people is not the white man. The children of your people are not Arabs.

We have never been taught that. We will love the white man before we love each other. We will love the Chinese and the Arabs before we love each other. We will love any other race first. A Chinese man shot a little black boy in the back and killed him, and he got off, and we are still going to go shop at the Chinese stores, because we prefer other races to our own race, as long as we can get that fake hair, the fake press on nails, the stupid makeup. They said he had a gun; they found no gun. To hell with them. That is why they look at us like we are dummies.

So when Colossians 1:28 says “warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus”, it is every man of the children of Israel. That is what Paul was labouring for and why he was afflicted: to bring the children of one people back to loving one another and keeping God’s commandments.
