classes.title: Lucifer: The Antichrist
Raising Cain: The Son of Perdition, Merchants, and Captive Nations

precepts.label: Luke 21:24
precepts.why:
“for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first.” What is the falling away? Slavery, captivity. And the precept for it is Luke: “And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.”

We fell by the edge of the sword, and we were led away as slaves into all nations. That is what happened to us. Before Christ returns, Israel had to fall away, and that falling away goes into a lot: it goes into us even forgetting our nationality and all of that.

The apostles asked Christ what they had to look for before his return and for the end, and Paul is explaining the same thing here. “Let no man deceive you by any means” is the same thing Christ said: don’t let anybody deceive you. All the prophets say the same thing in different words. Christ said Israel would be led captive until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled; Paul says the day of the Lord shall not come except there come a falling away first.

And while Israel is in that captivity, “that man of sin” must “be revealed, the son of perdition.” Instead of saying antichrist, Paul says the man of sin. It is not one person but a race, a people: Edom, the one Malachi says the prophets “shall call them, The border of wickedness.” That is the time we are living in now, with Israel fallen away into all nations and the prophets revealing the wicked, and that is why the day of the Lord has not yet come.

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 6:9
precepts.why:
Thessalonians says the man of sin will be revealed: not elected, not raised up, but made known, because he was already ordained. Ezra shows it was planned before anything was made: “In the beginning, when the earth was made, before the borders of the world stood, or ever the winds blew,” before paradise, the angels and the firmament. “Then did I consider these things, and they all were made through me alone, and through none other: by me also they shall be ended, and by none other.” Like an artist who sees the work in his mind first, the Lord had it all planned before He started making anything.

Ezra asks, “What shall be the parting asunder of the times? or when shall be the end of the first, and the beginning of it that followeth?” The answer: “From Abraham unto Isaac, when Jacob and Esau were born of him, Jacob’s hand held first the heel of Esau. For Esau is the end of the world, and Jacob is the beginning of it that followeth.” You want to know when the end is? Esau is the end, and you have to watch the signs to understand when it comes. The judgment was deferred for a time, but Jacob is the beginning of what follows.

Some say Jacob stole the birthright and was at fault. But if this was set from the foundation of the world, as it was in Cain’s spirit to do what he did, Jacob was not wrong. Neither had done good or evil in the womb, as Romans 9 says; grabbing the heel was a reflex in the spirit and a sign for our learning. Jacob was always supposed to be in rulership, but it was for a time.

So the son of perdition reveals himself by exalting himself, opposing God and seeking worship in these last days. The spirit of Cain came through the seed of Esau and grew from murder of a brother, to weapon maker, to global oppressor.

precepts.label: John 17:12
precepts.why:
Thessalonians calls the man of sin “the son of perdition,” and Christ used that same name in his prayer: “While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name.” This is Christ speaking of the righteous, the elect, in this present world. He kept them in the Father’s name by ministering to them, giving them the word, magnifying the law, breaking down the divisions and showing how they were to be unified under the commandments in the faith of Christ.

“Those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost.” The ones given to him are kept and sealed. John 17 has so many verses that smash the John 3:16 doctrine.

“But the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.” The son of perdition is not kept; he is ordained for destruction. That goes with 2 Esdras 6:9-10: the elect are preserved so that the end, Esau, and then the beginning that follows, Jacob, can come to pass.

Through the process of time Cain elevated himself in his bloodline, putting in place institutions, banking and all the rest, and became a global power. Then comes 2 Thessalonians 2:8: that wicked revealed, “whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth,” by the prophets preaching now, “and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming.”

precepts.label: Acts 15:5
precepts.why:
John is the only one in the Bible who calls a system or a person the antichrist. The prophets spoke of that last kingdom that would fight against Christ at his return, but they did not call it antichrist. John says “as ye have heard that antichrist shall come”, which is future, “even now are there many antichrists”. Anti means against. Even in John's time many were against Christ.

“They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us”. These were men among the apostles who up and left the apostles and their teachings, which were the teachings of Christ, and went out teaching against them. They said the resurrection had taken place already. They taught that you have to be circumcised. That is an antichrist doctrine, one form of antichrist in the time of the apostles.

That goes back to the history in Acts 15: “But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed, saying, That it was needful to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.” The Pharisees were pushing first and foremost that they had to be circumcised after the manner of Moses, meaning the old covenant of animal sacrifice, and not Christ. It is not only circumcision of the foreskin, because that is a law we have to do; it is that they pushed that before they pushed Christ.

So from the beginning there were many antichrists: those who went out from the apostles and taught contrary to Christ. That is why John says “they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.”

precepts.label: 1 Corinthians 10:1-6
precepts.why:
Jude says “I will therefore put you in remembrance, though ye once knew this, how that the Lord, having saved the people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.” He is going into history. When we left Egypt we went into the wilderness, and the Israelites rebelled and were put to death. Who else spoke of it in the New Testament? Paul, in Corinthians the tenth chapter. Write that down in your Bible.

“Moreover, brethren, I would not that ye should be ignorant, how that all our fathers were under the cloud”. Right here it tells you who the people in Corinth were. They weren't white people, weren't Europeans, weren't natural Greeks, Caucasians. They were Israelites: our fathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, not Abraham, Isaac and Esau. Under the cloud: the chariot that followed us. They “all passed through the sea; And were all baptized unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea”, because Moses taught the law and taught us Christ, the gospel.

“And did all eat the same spiritual meat; And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Christ.” Christ was always present. “But with many of them God was not well pleased: for they were overthrown in the wilderness”: for murmuring, gossiping, sex, fornication.

“Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.” These things were our examples, brothers. That is what Jude puts us in remembrance of: God saved a whole people and still destroyed those who believed not. Don't lust after evil things as they did, and earnestly contend for the faith once delivered unto the saints.

precepts.label: John 3:19
precepts.why:
Jude says the angels which kept not their first estate are reserved “in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.” Has that great day come yet, brothers? No. Those sons of God who went in unto the daughters of men were destroyed in the flood, and those spirits came right back, by way of the three sons, Ham, Shem and Japheth. They are still here today.

John shows what that darkness is: “And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.” Men loving darkness rather than light is sin: you hate God's laws, you hate this truth, you hate the Bible.

There are people like that who were ordained of old to stay like that, the “certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation”. Remember 2 Thessalonians: God gave them up to strong delusion, that they should believe a lie and not repent and come into the light. Some people are bound in that darkness, and there is nothing you can do for them. That is the chains of darkness, reserved unto the judgment of the great day.

precepts.label: Acts 26:17-18
precepts.why:
Christ sent Paul, “Delivering thee from the people, and from the Gentiles, unto whom now I send thee, To open their eyes, and to turn them from darkness to light”. To open our eyes, and turn us from darkness to light: from sin to righteousness.

Then, “and from the power of Satan unto God”: from the power of Satan, the prince of the power of the air, his evil communication, those unclean spirits that went out of the mouth of the dragon, the beast and the false prophet. So “that they may receive forgiveness of sins, and inheritance among them which are sanctified by faith that is in me.”

That is the other side of Jude. Some are bound in chains of darkness, loving darkness rather than light, ordained of old to that condemnation. But the ones Paul was sent to are turned from darkness to light and from Satan unto God, sanctified by faith in Christ. That is the faith once delivered unto the saints that we are earnestly contending for, casting down Esau's lies about fallen angels and Nephilim.

precepts.label: 2 Peter 2:1-6
precepts.why:
“But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them”. This is still going into the same ones Jude speaks of, what Esau calls Nephilim, because they are back today: the evil of our people. “And many shall follow their pernicious ways; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of. And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you”.

“For if God spared not the angels that sinned”. This is not literal angels up in heaven sinning against God. They cannot sin against God; they do his will, and when God tells them to do something, they do it. Stop listening to Esau, the pastors, preachers and congressmen talking about demons, Nephilim and fallen angels. That is a lie. This is the offspring of the sons of God. He “delivered them into chains of darkness”, and that is sin, “to be reserved unto judgment”, the same great day Jude talked about. What they did back then they will keep doing today; they are not going to change.

“And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly; And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow, making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly”. He destroyed the old world with water and saved Noah and his whole family.

So nobody is confused: Jude is not talking about Uriel having a fight with an angel, uppercutting him, and the angel falling from heaven. That is garbage malarkey. Black folks live by the saying there is nothing new under the sun, and we get that from the Bible; apply the same logic here.

thread.label: Revelation 2:9-10
thread.text: I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich) and I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.

precepts.label: Revelation 3:9
precepts.why:
“I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich)”. Christ knows the works of the Israelites in the church of Smyrna, a colony of Israelites, and the hell they caught there, hunted by Herod for Rome. They were impoverished, but he reminded them they are rich, because all the promises in the Bible pertain only to the Israelites.

“And I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.” That is why you have people like Herod, who said he was Jewish, and Agrippa and Bernice in Acts. You want to call it hate speech; we are reading from the Bible. Then: “behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison”. That is Herod and Rome, and he calls them the devil.

Revelation 3:9 gives the end of it: “Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before thy feet, and to know that I have loved thee.”

That is a future prophecy that has not occurred yet. Today the synagogue of Satan sits in the land calling itself Jewish; the day is coming when they will worship before the feet of the real Jews and know that God loved us. Until then, “be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.”

precepts.label: Wisdom of Solomon 2:1-16
precepts.why:
Wisdom of Solomon 2 lets you hear the synagogue of Satan think. “For the ungodly said, reasoning with themselves, but not aright, Our life is short and tedious, and in the death of a man there is no remedy: neither was there any man known to have returned from the grave.” This ungodly is Esau.

Now watch what Esau says about us. “He was made to reprove our thoughts.” The Israelite man, the prophet, was made to reprove their thoughts. “He is grievous unto us even to behold”: just looking at us grieves them, because we are a constant reminder that we are the sons of God and they are not. “For his life is not like other men’s, his ways are of another fashion”, because we keep the commandments of God.

“We are esteemed of him as counterfeits”. That goes to Revelation 2:9 and 3:9: they are counterfeits, fakes, frauds; they are not the real Jews. The Bible calls them counterfeits; those are not my words, those are the words of God. “He abstaineth from our ways as from filthiness: he pronounceth the end of the just to be blessed”.

So those which say they are Jews and are not know it themselves. The righteous man grieves them, and that is why the devil casts some of us into prison. Be faithful unto death.

precepts.label: Isaiah 27:1
precepts.why:
Daniel said, “And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered.” That time is Armageddon, when all nations rise up and fight, and Michael rises up to fight for us. Revelation 12 is the same thing: “And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon.” It's not talking about war in the sky, as Christians say, Lucifer fighting with God and his angels. It's all nations fighting with each other. This is the time of trouble.

“and the dragon fought and his angels.” Who is the dragon? Lucifer: America and Europe. His angels are his armies. Isaiah proves it: “In that day the Lord with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent, even leviathan that crooked serpent; and he shall slay the dragon that is in the sea.”

Leviathan, the piercing serpent, that crooked serpent, is the white man. And the dragon that is in the sea is America. The Lord will punish him with his great and strong sword in that day, the same day Michael stands up for Daniel's people and they are delivered.

precepts.label: Psalms 74:13-14
precepts.why:
“Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.” Remember what we read: “the dragon fought and his angels.” That's what we are reading about here: Christ and Michael and the angels fighting against the white man and his army.

“Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.” The heads of leviathan are all the heads: Europe, France, all of them; America, all of them. Christ is going to destroy that dragon, the whole government.

That is why Revelation says the dragon and his angels “prevailed not; neither was their place found any more in heaven.” They don't win against Michael and the angels. When Christ returns, Michael and the angels fight against the white man and his army, and every head of leviathan is broken in pieces.

precepts.label: Isaiah 24:21-22
precepts.why:
This explains the war in heaven: “And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth. And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit.” The high ones that are on high are the people ruling. The Lord is going to punish Europe and America, and the kings of the earth too. The gathering into the pit goes into Revelation 20.

Isaiah 34 shows what heaven means. “For the indignation of the Lord is upon all nations, and his fury upon all their armies”: in Revelation their armies are called his angels. “he hath utterly destroyed them, he hath delivered them to the slaughter.” “And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll.” “For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.” Is this heaven paradise? No. This heaven is the governments of this world, and the sword comes down upon Idumea, Edom, the people of his curse.

So the dragon in Revelation 12 is Edom, the fourth beast, also called the Devil and Satan. That war in heaven is Christ fighting with the white man and his armies: Lucifer falling from heaven: how art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer. “neither was their place found any more in heaven”: they have no rulership any more on this earth. And the one “which deceiveth the whole world” is not just a spiritual demon; it's his children, the white man, Edom, Lucifer, that transformed himself into an angel of light.

thread.text: And the serpent cast out of his mouth water as a flood after the woman, that he might cause her to be carried away of the flood.

classes.title: Prophesy From Pain to Peace

precepts.label: Revelation 13:5-6
precepts.why:
“And the serpent cast out of his mouth water as a flood after the woman”. His mouth is the media, America’s media, and every single aspect of it is so-called Jewish owned; Amalek controls all the media, and Trump wants to control the whole of it. The water out of the serpent’s mouth is lies. The woman is our people, and the flood is to draw as many of the twelve tribes of Israel as they can into their Christian or democratic lies. That is their agenda.

Revelation 13 describes that mouth: “And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies; and power was given unto him to continue forty and two months. And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, and them that dwell in heaven.”

In the time of Rome they had written media, pamphlets they sent out everywhere. It started with Rome; the Americans have it top-notch today, and their messages go out worldwide. That mouth speaking great things and blasphemies is the same mouth casting out the flood after the woman.

precepts.label: Daniel 7:11
precepts.why:
Daniel saw it too: “I beheld then because of the voice of the great words which the horn spake”. Write this down: the horn is America. The voice is their media today, and it goes worldwide; even in Cuba there was American news on certain channels.

“I beheld even till the beast was slain, and his body destroyed, and given to the burning flame.” Now he calls the horn the beast, and it is destined to be destroyed. Revelation 18:8 is the precept: “Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire: for strong is the Lord God who judgeth her.” That is the body given to the burning flame.

“And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning”. They will cry for this horn, this America.

So the mouth that casts out the flood after the woman is the same voice of great words that brings the beast to the burning flame.

precepts.label: Daniel 7:25
precepts.why:
“And he shall speak great words against the most High”: through their media, the same blasphemies we read in Revelation 13.

“And shall wear out the saints of the most High”. How did they wear us out? In slavery: shackles on our necks, our hands and our ankles; buck breaking; working seven days a week from sunup to sundown. That is what wearing out the saints means.

“And think to change times and laws”: the daylight saving time we just entered; laws like same-sex marriage; our Sabbath changed to Sunday.

“And they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time”: 250 years. What we need to see in this verse is that he speaks great words against the Most High, and that is their media, the mouth of the serpent casting its flood of lies after the woman.

precepts.label: Jeremiah 51:54-57
precepts.why:
“A sound of a cry cometh from Babylon, and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans”. Babylon here is America, and the Chaldeans are modern Israel today. The Chaldeans were always an ally to Babylon: ancient Babylon were Kushites and the Chaldeans Semites, so brought up to today, America is Babylon and the Israelis are the Chaldeans.

“Because the Lord hath spoiled Babylon, and destroyed out of her the great voice”. What is the great voice? Their media, which goes worldwide and captivates and hypnotizes people everywhere. “When her waves do roar like great waters, a noise of their voice is uttered”: the waves are the nations within her.

“Because the spoiler is come upon her, even upon Babylon”, as we read in Habakkuk, “and her mighty men are taken”, as prisoners of war, “every one of their bows is broken: for the Lord God of recompences shall surely requite.”

“And I will make drunk her princes, and her wise men, her captains”, the admirals and generals, “and her rulers”, the governors and mayors, “and her mighty men”, the soldiers: “and they shall sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake”. That perpetual sleep is the lake of fire; they are never waking up again. So the serpent’s mouth, the great voice, will be destroyed out of her.

precepts.label: Isaiah 17:12-13
precepts.why:
Jeremiah 51:55 says “when her waves do roar like great waters, a noise of their voice is uttered”. The waves that roar are the nations, and Isaiah 17 is the precept that proves it.

“Woe to the multitude of many people, which make a noise like the noise of the seas; and to the rushing of nations, that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters!” The nations are the waters, making a noise like the seas.

“The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters: but God shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind.”

So the waters in these prophecies are peoples and nations. The waves roaring within Babylon are the nations inside her, and however they rush, God will rebuke them and chase them like chaff before the wind.

thread.text: And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.

precepts.label: Revelation 13:11
precepts.why:
The three unclean spirits like frogs come “out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.” Those three unclean spirits are politics, religion and finance. To see the first of them, go to the beast of Revelation 13.

John says, “I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb, and he spake as a dragon.” Those two horns like a lamb are the two political parties, the Democrats and the Republicans: two political systems that look gentle like a lamb. But he speaks as a dragon.

That is the politics, the frog that comes out of the mouth of the dragon. And what comes out of a mouth? Communication, and that communication is propaganda, persuasion and lies. These are “the spirits of devils”, and they do not stay at home: they “go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world”, gathering them “to the battle of that great day of God Almighty.”

precepts.label: Revelation 13:16-17
precepts.why:
The second frog comes “out of the mouth of the beast.” Go back to Revelation 13: “he causeth all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads: And that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.”

That no man might buy or sell: that is the finance, one of the three unclean spirits like frogs, alongside the politics and the religion.

It is coming to a time where, if you are not in cahoots with, in support of, or in allegiance with what America pushes, you will not be able to buy or sell. On a large scale that is trade between nations, but it is also the regular buying and selling of everyday life. That is why they are trying to do away with the currency as it is now and bring everything into a digital system: to monitor God's people who speak up against this society.

The third frog, out of the mouth of the false prophet, is Christianity, their religion and their religious systems. Politics, finance and religion together are the spirits of devils working miracles, going out to the kings of the whole world, not only here at home.

precepts.label: Revelation 18:1-4
precepts.why:
Revelation 17 ends with the woman: “the waters which thou sawest, where the whore sitteth, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.” Put up the Statue of Liberty: Lady Liberty sits upon many waters; she is everywhere. The ten horns, Belgium, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Germany, the United Kingdom, Italy, Greece, France, Denmark and Ireland, “shall hate the whore, and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.” It will be an ambush; the entire country will be destroyed. “And the woman which thou sawest is that great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth.” We call it a country; God calls it a great city. Nobody dominates America; America reigns over everybody.

Then chapter 18 opens right after: “Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.” Why does it say fallen twice? Because Israel is the little Babylon.

“For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication”: her policies, the same thing Daniel 8 says, that through his policy he shall cause craft to prosper. All nations follow their policies. “And the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her”: the nations got in bed with her. “And the merchants of the earth”, the corporations and companies, “are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies.”

“Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.” That lets you know where the Israelites are: in Babylon. They say Babylon is Iraq. No, no, no: it is letting you know the twelve tribes are here.

precepts.label: Deuteronomy 28:48
precepts.why:
Babylon's merchandise runs from “gold, and silver, and precious stones” down to “slaves, and souls of men.” The tin, the copper, the iron, the rubber, the bauxite, the slaves and the cheap labor have all been taken out of our countries. These countries are not underdeveloped; they are overexploited. They all should be rich countries, world powers, with the blessings the Lord gave us in those places. It was done in Latin America and in Africa, especially the west coast where we are dispersed, and the slave routes and trade routes were the commerce they made of us.

The way they keep that dominance today is economic, backed by the threat of military power, and it follows a pattern, as with Noriega and now Maduro. First they criminalize the leader with drug, terror and corruption narratives, framing mischief by a law. Then they declare the regime illegitimate. Then they apply sanctions and economic siege. Then they isolate the country diplomatically and militarily, remove or extract the leadership, and install or manage a transition authority.

The sanctions are the modern face of Deuteronomy 28:48, for those who say the curses were only for back then or only for the time of the conquistadors: “Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things”. Want of all things because of sanctions and their economic might. If you try to nationalize your resources or do things outside of their money, even though you have your own resources you are overexploited to the point that you cannot do it on your own. There is no might in your hand.

“and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” A lot of times we did this willingly. It is the same pattern we followed with Assyria and Egypt: when the United States became a world power we leaned on them, and found out really quick that they do not keep their word on anything. It is history repeating itself, the doctrine of the scripture executed over and over again.

precepts.label: Revelation 2:9
precepts.why:
“I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich).” First and foremost, the riches are the promise of the kingdom of heaven. Unto us pertain the promises, the law, the adoption of sons, all of it; we are the ones Christ died for. That is the true riches.

But Revelation 18 gives it a new spin. Babylon trades in gold, silver, precious stones, fine wood, iron and marble, and these come out of our lands. So-called third world countries are rich with resources; it is the people who are poor, because they are overexploited. What a distinction. The countries of Israel are not underdeveloped, and the poverty of our people sits on top of the riches of our lands.

“and I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.” Those who say they are Jews and are not are part of the same machine working to oppress our people, and it is the same playbook of sanctions, isolation and regime change that runs through the whole system.

So Revelation 2:9 stands beside Revelation 18:12: the merchants of Babylon grow rich off the goods of the lands where Israel is scattered, while Israel lives in tribulation and poverty, though rich in the promises and in the land itself.

precepts.label: Revelation 22:8-9
precepts.why:
John says it twice. In Revelation 19 he fell at the angel's feet, and here again: “I John saw these things, and heard them. And when I had heard and seen, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel which shewed me these things.”

And the angel says the same thing again: “See thou do it not: for I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren the prophets, and of them which keep the sayings of this book: worship God.” He will not take worship, because he is not God. He is a fellowservant, one of the brethren.

That is who the angels are: our brothers. They are not demons. They ate with Lot because they have mouths just like us, and they were going to lie down because they look like us. Esau calls them humanoids, and to Esau they are going to be some demons, but those are our brothers. The angels have tribes too, and in Revelation 21, do not be surprised if the angels standing at the twelve gates are each standing at the gate of their own tribe.

precepts.label: Tobit 5:12-14
precepts.why:
Here Raphael, before he makes himself known, presents himself to Tobit another way: “I am Azarias, the son of Ananias the great, and of thy brethren.” An angel of God naming himself as one of the brethren, just as the angel told John, “I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren.”

Tobit answers, “Thou art welcome, brother; be not now angry with me, because I have enquired to know thy tribe and thy family; for thou art my brother, of an honest and good stock.” Tobit asks after his tribe and his family, and receives him as a brother.

He knows his people: “I know Ananias and Jonathas, sons of that great Samaias, as we went together to Jerusalem to worship, and offered the firstborn, and the tenths of the fruits; and they were not seduced with the error of our brethren: my brother, thou art of a good stock.”

So the angel who walked with Tobit's son was taken for an Israelite brother, of a tribe and a family. That is how close the angels are to us: they look like us, they have tribes too, and they are our brethren.

precepts.label: Tobit 12:15
precepts.why:
Now Raphael makes himself known: “I am Raphael, one of the seven holy angels, which present the prayers of the saints, and which go in and out before the glory of the Holy One.” The one Tobit called brother, Azarias of his brethren, was the angel all along.

Why do the angels present the prayers of the saints? Because they minister unto us. They are ministering spirits working on our behalf, because those are our brothers.

They are not demonic spirits sent here to oppose the people that inhabit this place called the United Snakes of America. That is untrue. That is popular persuasion; that is lies. The world is being taught to call what comes out of the heavens demons and fallen angels, so that it will gather to fight against Christ and his army. But the angels are our brethren, fellowservants who keep the testimony of Jesus, and we worship God alone.

thread.label: Revelation 19:11-20
thread.text: And I saw heaven opened, and behold a white horse; and he that sat upon him was called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he doth judge and make war.

classes.title: Popular Persuasions: Fighting Against Heaven Defending Earth

precepts.label: Isaiah 47:3
precepts.why:
The armies in heaven follow Christ “upon white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and clean.” That fine linen, white and clean, is the immortal body. To prove it, go to Isaiah, speaking to Babylon: “Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.”

Christ said he is going to take vengeance, and he will not meet Babylon as a man. Christ is coming back with that immortal body. You will not be able to nail him back to the cross like you did in Jerusalem.

That is what the white horse and the fine linen, white and clean, make reference to. And he comes to make war, because God is a man of war: “in righteousness he doth judge and make war.” His vesture is dipped in blood, because there is going to be a lot of bloodshed, a lot of killing. On his head are many crowns, because he is going to take everyone's crowns and be the one King, “KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.”

precepts.label: Wisdom of Solomon 5:1-6
precepts.why:
Revelation says the beast and the kings of the earth and their armies were gathered together to make war against him that sits on the horse. Wisdom shows what happens when they see him: “Then shall the righteous man stand in great boldness before the face of such as have afflicted him, and made no account of his labours.” That is us, the Israelites, standing before Esau and the nations, who made no account of our labours here.

“When they see it, they shall be troubled with terrible fear, and shall be amazed at the strangeness of his salvation, so far beyond all that they looked for.” The strangeness of his salvation is the chariots, us being taken up. That is going to be strange and foreign to them. They will no longer talk about the deliverance out of Egypt, but about the new deliverance from the land of the north. A black God, a black Christ, coming to redeem his black people: that is going to be the new talk of the town.

“And they repenting and groaning for anguish of spirit shall say within themselves, This was he, whom we had sometimes in derision, and a proverb of reproach.” Christ is going to put it in their mind: these are the people you afflicted, raped, robbed, murdered and enslaved. These are my people.

“We fools accounted his life madness, and his end to be without honour: How is he numbered among the children of God, and his lot is among the saints! Therefore have we erred from the way of truth.”

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 13:1-11
precepts.why:
Revelation says the armies were gathered together to make war against him that sat on the horse and against his army. Ezra saw that same war. “there arose a wind from the sea”, and “that man waxed strong with the thousands of heaven: and when he turned his countenance to look, all the things trembled.” The man that came out of the sea is Christ, with the thousands of heaven, the armies that follow him.

And “whensoever the voice went out of his mouth, all they burned that heard his voice, like as the earth faileth when it feeleth the fire.” He speaks the laws out of his mouth, and the people just disintegrate, because they are guilty of that law. That is the sharp sword out of his mouth in Revelation, the laws of God.

Then “there was gathered together a multitude of men, out of number, from the four winds of the heaven, to subdue the man that came out of the sea”. They will have one consent, because the Most High is going to harden them like he did Pharaoh. And the popular persuasion is already laying the groundwork: let's all come together and fight the demons coming from space.

After this, “all they which were gathered together to subdue him were sore afraid, and yet durst fight.” Scared to death, but the Most High moves them. As Romans 9 shows, he built them up, just like ancient Egypt: Babylon the Great, this white man, this Edomite, built up just to be destroyed, made to fight against him.

And “he neither lifted up his hand, nor held sword, nor any instrument of war”, but sent out of his mouth “a blast of fire”, “a flaming breath”, and “sparks and tempests”, and “burned them up every one, so that upon a sudden of an innumerable multitude nothing was to be perceived, but only dust and smell of smoke.” Ashes to ashes, and dust to dust.

thread.label: Revelation 22:16
thread.text: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.

classes.title: Lucifer: The Antichrist

precepts.label: Numbers 24:17
precepts.why:
Christ says, “I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.” So who is the morning star? Christ is the morning star. Then why is Lucifer called “son of the morning”? The King James is the only version with Lucifer there, because the scholars who translated it understood something everybody else did not: there is a difference between that morning star and the morning star we read about all through the scriptures.

Balaam saw the true star: “I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob”. A star out of who? Out of Jacob. Did it say out of Esau? No: out of Jacob.

“and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel”: a ruler shall rise out of Israel. “and shall smite the corners of Moab”, the Moabites, the Chinese, “and destroy all the children of Sheth.”

So the star in the scriptures is Christ, the ruler rising out of Israel, the offspring of David. The star comes out of Jacob, not Esau, and that is how we know the one called Lucifer, the false morning star, is a different one.

precepts.label: 2 Peter 1:19
precepts.why:
“We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts”. So you see who is referred to as the star, the bright morning star: Christ, the day star that arises in your hearts.

Then why is the king of Babylon, America, referred to as Lucifer? Because “such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.” “And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.” The white man came and taught another Christ and transformed himself into an apostle of Christ. America transformed itself in the 1950s into a God-loving Christian nation, and for the last seventy years has pushed that it is here to set up righteousness and justice on the earth, after murdering, stealing, colonizing and enslaving millions of people.

That is why Isaiah calls him “Lucifer, son of the morning”: he says he is Christian, righteous, the light, and makes himself look like the morning star. But Christ is the real morning star, “the true Light”, and the day star Peter speaks of arises in the hearts of those who take heed to the sure word of prophecy.

precepts.label: Jeremiah 1:5
precepts.why:
Ezra says every one that shall be saved, and shall escape by his works, by keeping the commandments, and by faith in what is written, “Shall be preserved from the said perils, and shall see my salvation in my land, and within my borders: for I have sanctified them for me from the beginning.” That is when the kingdom is set up. And why does he say he sanctified them from the beginning? Jeremiah shows it.

“Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee.” Where did he know us? In spirit. This is a physical domain, but he knew us in the spirit world, in another dimension. He did something to our spirit before our parents had relations to bring us forth. You are here because of a conversation God had with you before you even came into this world.

So you people are here because God cares about you. You are not here by accident. There is something in your spirit that God said, I need to fix you, so that when the time comes to destroy the earth, you come back to me and are not in your pride.

The third of Israelites were sanctified from the beginning, from the foundation of the earth. He said, these spirits I am going to love, and these spirits I am going to reject and destroy. God is good all the time to the people that keep his commandments. To you people breaking God’s laws, he is not good. So do not listen to anybody saying God is good all the time; that is not scriptural.

That is why the rest of the chapter is so hard: those who abused his ways, loathed his law while they had liberty and despised the place of repentance “must know it after death by pain.” The sanctified are preserved; the proud are not.

thread.text: For, behold, the burning wrath of a great multitude is kindled over you, and they shall take away certain of you, and feed you, being idle, with things offered unto idols.

classes.title: Prophesy From Pain to Peace

precepts.label: 1 Timothy 4:1-3
precepts.why:
The great multitude “shall take away certain of you, and feed you, being idle, with things offered unto idols.” What does that mean? It is talking about Christianity. If you are idle, they are going to feed you Christianity. How do we know? Paul prophesied it: “Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils”.

We already know some of you are going to depart from this faith. Why? Because persecution is coming, and when you cannot pay your bills and cannot get food, you will leave. America wants to bring in digital currency so they can control us. In China, if you jaywalk, they take money out of your account; imagine being told you may not teach the gospel or gather on the seventh day, and when we do it anyway, your digital bank account is hit.

What is the doctrine of devils? Paul explains it: “Speaking lies in hypocrisy; having their conscience seared with a hot iron; Forbidding to marry, and commanding to abstain from meats”. What religion forbids men to marry? Catholicism, Christianity. Commanding to abstain from meats: that is Lent, no meat for 40 days. That is the food offered to idols: Christianity, Roman Catholicism.

Why will they feed it to you? Because you do not study. When persecution comes, you are fearful, you cannot endure to the end, so you give up and betray the King of kings. And “they that consent unto them shall be had in derision and in reproach, and trodden under foot.” Even the white man hates a traitor. In the Planet of the Apes the apes who betrayed their own wore the word donkey on their backs, and when they were no longer needed, they were killed. Then you face the King, and the lake of fire. But those who endure, “Then shall they be known, who are my chosen; and they shall be tried as the gold in the fire.”

thread.text: And it happened, after that Alexander son of Philip, the Macedonian, who came out of the land of Chettiim, had smitten Darius king of the Persians and Medes, that he reigned in his stead, the first over Greece,

precepts.label: Daniel 11:39
precepts.why:
Alexander “parted his kingdom among them, while he was yet alive”, and “his servants bare rule every one in his place.” His generals divided it up: Ptolemy took Egypt, Lysimachus took Thrace and Asia Minor, Seleucus took Syria, and Cassander took Macedonia. Alexander had everything united as one; they could not unite, so they divided the kingdom.

Daniel shows the pattern: “Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god, whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory”. Back then, in the time of the Greeks, the strange gods were Zeus, Aphrodite and the like. The strange god today is Caesar Borgia.

It goes on, “and he shall cause them to rule over many”: he causes his people to rule over many nations, many countries. He “shall divide the land for gain.” That is what Alexander's generals did.

Many of these scriptures have levels to them. It started with the Greeks, but Esau kept that same energy at the Berlin Conference in the late 1800s. No Africans, no Negroes and no Latinos were in that meeting; it was about white supremacy, and they divided up the entire continent of Africa for gain, and the land of Israel with it. That is what the Balfour Declaration was about: some of these so-called Khazars wanted that land.

precepts.label: Psalms 55:21
precepts.why:
The Greeks and then the Europeans divided the land for gain. David shows how they got in: “The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.”

When the white man comes, his words are smoother than butter. He will talk about Jesus, about love, about honour and respect, and you will fall in love with what he says. But his intent all along was war and to destroy you.

They did not come into Africa talking war. They came with missionaries who talked the love of white Jesus: we love you, dusty Africans. In Africa you have Hamites and Shemites; the Shemites are the Bantus, and the Nilotes are the Hamites, who were their mercenaries. They brought their religions, spoke words of peace, learned our strengths and our weaknesses, and then devastated us with colonialism and slavery. That is how they divided Africa for financial gain, and why Africa is not united today.

Kwame Nkrumah wanted to unite the entire continent with one visa and one financial system backed by gold. The CIA said, we got to get rid of this dude, and he was run out of Ghana to Guinea.

They taught us to read but not to reason. That is why people get confused over Romans 9:13 and John 3:16: they can read, but they cannot reason. Softer than oil, yet drawn swords: behind every smooth word, the intent was war.

precepts.label: Hosea 8:4
precepts.why:
Judas heard of the Romans, “that they were mighty and valiant men”, and that “by their policy and patience they had conquered all the place”. With their friends they “kept amity”, but whom they would help to a kingdom, those reigned, and whom they would, they displaced. Hosea shows Israel doing the very thing: “They have set up kings, but not by me: they have made princes, and I knew it not”.

Ephraim, the northern kingdom, did the same with Assyria and with Egypt. We were always trying to go to other countries to get leverage, never realizing that all we had to do was return to God, reunite with the southern kingdom, keep God's commandments the way they were given, and be one people.

Those same tendencies are here to this day. When the United States became a world power it did what Rome did. Rome trained proxy rulers, like Herod, an Edomite set as ruler over us in Israel; America trains proxy militaries and governments through the School of the Americas, renamed the Western Hemisphere Institute for Security Cooperation, and removes the leaders who resist. That is how they made princes: they trained the Jasons, the ungodly wretches who turned against their own people, the dictators of the northern kingdom countries of Latin America.

Then: “of their silver and their gold have they made them idols, that they may be cut off.” They traded their resources and leveraged what they had to put these people in front of them. Whom they would help, they helped; whom they would weaken, they weakened; whom they would remove, they removed. That sums up the School of the Americas, and the 56 interventions in Latin America: the spirit of Cain coming through Esau, from Rome to America.
